raw.description:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the position:

As a Customer Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end implementations for G-P’s largest and most complex global customers—organizations expanding across multiple countries and adopting multiple products. You will partner with Sales before the contract is signed to scope the engagement and own the customer relationship until every committed hire is live on payroll, as well as lead major post-launch initiatives like new country launches, bulk onboarding, and M&A expansions.

You are not an HR expert; you are an execution expert who knows what needs to happen, in what order, by when, and who owns it. You serve as the customer’s single point of contact and own the master project plan, partnering closely with regional HR Operations leaders who manage in-country compliance, payroll, and benefits execution.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead pre-sales scoping: Partner with Sales and internal teams to scope multi-product, multi-country deals—setting realistic, country-by-country timelines and pushing back when dates aren't achievable.
  • Own the master project plan: Build and maintain a single, clear delivery plan covering milestones, dependencies, and owners across both the customer and G-P.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Coordinate Legal, IT/Integrations, Product, and Support while partnering closely with regional Operations counterparts who lead in-country delivery.
  • Manage integrations early: Identify HRIS, payroll, and finance integration needs upfront and keep technical workstreams on track alongside core onboarding.

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Hospital Coding Specialist, you will help the clinical team and billing department ensure the accuracy and integrity of medical records so they can maximize optimal reimbursement while remaining fully compliant with regulatory standards.

Every day you will review complex inpatient and outpatient medical documentation to assign precise diagnosis and procedure codes. You will be expected to maintain high levels of productivity and accuracy, compose professional provider queries, and troubleshoot documentation trends to resolve billing inquiries.

To be successful in this role, you must possess strong technical proficiency in CPT and ICD coding, a deep understanding of regulatory compliance guidelines, and the ability to analyze medical documentation to identify and resolve complex coding discrepancies.

As a remote employee, we will provide you with the equipment needed to work from home, including a laptop, docking station, dual monitors, and accessories.

Job Requirements

Required

  • 1 year inpatient coding experience and Coding Certificate (Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), RHIT, RHIA or Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) OR
  • Bachelor’s degree in HIM and Coding Certificate (CCS, RHIA, or CIC) OR
  • Associate's degree in HIM and Coding Certificate.

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy and physiology.

  • Experience reviewing provider documentation and assigning appropriate ICD10-CM, PCS and CPT codes.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • In-depth knowledge of regulatory and payer guidelines to ensure compliant coding.

  • Ability to meet accuracy and productivity metrics consistently.

  • Ability to work independently, with a HIPAA compliant workstation, and high-speed Internet.

  • Consistently maintains professional credentials and knowledge of current ICD10-CM, ICD10-PCS and CPT coding guidelines and government regulations.

  • Ability to query physicians to clarify conflicting or incomplete documentation in the medical record.

Where You’ll Work

Virginia Mason Franciscan Health has a rich history of providing exceptional healthcare, dating back to 1891. Building upon a legacy of compassionate care and innovation, our organization has evolved over the years through strategic partnerships and integrations to expand our reach and services across the Puget Sound area.Today, as Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, we remain deeply committed to healing the whole person – body, mind, and spirit – in the communities we serve. This commitment is strengthened by the diverse expertise and shared values brought together through our growth.Our dedicated providers offer a full spectrum of health care services, from routine wellness to complex disease management, all grounded in rigorous research and education. Our comprehensive network of 10 hospitals and nearly 300 care sites strategically located across the greater Puget Sound region reflects our ongoing commitment to accessibility and comprehensive care.We are proud of our pioneering medical advances and numerous awards and accreditations that reflect our dedication to excellence. When you join Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, you become part of a team that delivers top-quality, professional healthcare in modern, well-equipped facilities, and contributes to a legacy of service built on collaboration and shared purpose.

Role: AI Trainer (ML Engineering)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contract

Time Commitment: 15+ hours per week

Schedule: Flexible

Required Skills: ML Engineering, AI Training, Programming skills

You will use your machine learning expertise to create challenging technical tasks, evaluate model-generated work, identify failures, and establish objective standards for correct solutions. This role is intended for candidates who have already completed substantive AI-training work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Create realistic machine learning engineering tasks that challenge advanced AI models.

  • Develop task instructions, reproducible environments, reference solutions, and evaluation criteria.

  • Evaluate model-generated code, experiments, analyses, and technical deliverables.

  • Identify issues involving data leakage, incorrect validation, unstable training, performance, or reproducibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior paid experience training, evaluating, benchmarking, or improving AI systems.

  • Strong practical proficiency with Python.

  • Hands-on experience using PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or comparable ML tools.

Public Proof of Skill

Strong applicants should provide evidence such as:

  • GitHub repositories or public model implementations

  • Kaggle, DrivenData, AIcrowd, or similar competition results

  • Hugging Face models or datasets

  • Research publications or technical reports

  • Open-source ML contributions

  • Public benchmarks, experiments, or technical projects

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating AI-training tasks, reference answers, rubrics, graders, or benchmark problems.

  • Experience reviewing other AI trainers’ technical submissions.

  • Kaggle Expert, Master, or Grandmaster status, or strong results in another technical competition.

  • Publications or open-source contributions in machine learning.

  • Prior experience with long-horizon or agentic AI evaluations.

  • Availability to begin immediately.

Application Process

  1. Submit your application, AI-training experience, and public technical evidence.

  2. Complete an AI interview containing technical and integrity checks.

  3. Complete a hiring-manager review.

  4. If selected, complete project onboarding and begin your first assigned task.

Compensation

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid for tasks that meet project specifications and quality requirements. Task availability and completion time may vary.

Practice Test Content Editor, ELA

Study.com helps learners achieve their education and career goals with engaging, high‑quality learning content. We are looking for passionate individuals to work online and edit practice test questions to help students prepare for various professional certification exams.

About the Role

We are seeking detail‑oriented Content Editors to review and revise practice question content. You will train on the guidelines for a specific exam, then evaluate and edit questions against given quality, rigor, style and formatting standards. This role is fully remote. You’ll work independently, manage your own time, and follow clear documentation to ensure consistent, high‑quality outcomes. This is an online, remote contract role. All work is paid hourly.

Project Description

- Follow internal documentation to improve content clarity, authenticity to exam questions, and option and explanation quality
- Use exam content guides to validate that questions assess the provided skills
- Use copyediting skills to follow formatting conventions and ensure language and tone are compliant with DEI policies

Required Skills:

- Strong editorial judgment for educational materials, with an eye for clarity, fairness, and learner‑appropriate rigor
- Meticulous attention to detail and consistency for question accuracy and alignment to the exam’s content guide
- Willingness to learn about instructional design and train on new exams
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and follow structured procedures

Required Qualifications:

- A bachelors degree in Physics

- 3-5 years of working experience in your field of expertise
- Experience editing or developing educational content, assessments, or test‑prep materials
- Excellent written English and command of grammar, syntax, and tone for adult learners
- Familiarity with DEI guidelines for content publication
- Reliable internet and your own computer

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree
  • Background in K‑12, higher education, or test prep
  • Experience with content management systems
  • Familiarity with best practices in practice question design
  • Experience with wiki‑style formatting and copyediting
  • MathJax/LaTeX familiarity for occasional formatting tasks

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

raw.description:
California, US residentsclick here.

The job details are as follows:

Who We Are

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.


United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).


The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

Who You Are

Are you ready to play a critical role in strengthening United Therapeutics’ global pharmacovigilance partnership framework by ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely safety data exchange across global business partners, affiliates, alliances, and QPPVs. This role provides expert operational governance of partner-related case management, reconciliation, reporting quality, and compliance activities to support accurate processing and submission of post-marketing adverse events in alignment with UT procedures and applicable global requirements.

Serving as a key escalation point and strategic advisor, this role will evaluate complex ICSR, governance, regulatory, and inspection-readiness issues; recommend risk-based solutions; and lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance partnership oversight, improve process efficiency, and help protect

patient safety through complete, consistent, and reliable safety reporting.


  • Oversee day-to-day quality, compliance, case-management, data exchange, and reconciliation activities for UT global business partners to ensure discrepancies are resolved and post-marketing adverse events are processed and submitted in accordance with UT procedures and applicable requirements
  • Maintain unified safety data exchange procedures and monitoring controls that support complete, accurate, timely, and consistent partner reporting activities
  • Monitor global regulations, guidelines, and industry practices related to safety data collection, end-to-end case management, and data exchange, and provide expert guidance regarding operational implementation
  • Evaluate complex ICSR compliance, governance, quality, safety-reporting, inspection, and regulatory issues, and recommend risk-based solutions that consider patient safety, regulatory obligations, business objectives, and operational feasibility
  • Serve as the primary functional escalation point for partner-related compliance, governance, quality, reconciliation, and safety-reporting issues involving UT business partners, GPS affiliates, partner alliances, and QPPVs
  • Recommend improvements to partnership oversight programs, functional practices, governance processes, quality systems, and operating procedures based on identified risks, performance trends, and business needs
  • Initiate and lead projects and cross-functional initiatives that improve partner oversight, process efficiency, reporting quality, compliance, and inspection readiness
  • Contribute to departmental planning and implementation of goals for the GPS Partnership Program Oversight function within established functional objectives
  • Develop and deliver procedures, training, and supporting materials for adverse event, product complaint, and special reporting situation collection and reporting in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements
  • Act as a functional subject matter expert and point of contact during inspections and audits involving partner safety data exchange and GVP case-management processes
  • Conduct root-cause analyses and support the timely development, implementation, and closure of corrective and preventive actions arising from partner-related inspection findings, audit observations, deviations, or compliance issues
  • Review and approve partner-related deviations and corrective and preventive actions within assigned authority
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education and Experience requirements for Senior Global Safety Partnership Oversight Manager level:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a bachelor's degree, or
  • 8+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a master's degree, or
  • 5+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a PharmD
  • 4+ years of product development and/or postmarketing drug experience
  • 4+ years of experience as QPPV, deputy QPPV, or supporting role
  • 4+ years of experience in operations oversight (mgmt. of KPIs, compliance, metrics, etc.)
  • 4+ years of experience in managing or implementing PVAs with international business partners

Education and Experience requirements for Associate Global Safety Partnership Oversight Director level:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field
  • 12+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a bachelor's degree, or
  • 10+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a master's degree, or
  • 7+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a PharmD or international equivalent
  • 6+ years of experience as QPPV, deputy QPPV, or related supporting function
  • 6+ years of experience in operations oversight (management of KPIs, compliance, metrics, etc.)
  • 6+ years of experience in managing or implementing PVAs with international business partners

Minimum Requirements

  • Prior pharmacovigilance experience with demonstrated expertise in safety data exchange, adverse event reporting, compliance oversight, and partnership management activities supporting global pharmacovigilance operations
  • Advanced knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations, guidance, and industry best practices related to safety data exchange, adverse event reporting, reconciliation, and end-to-end case management for drugs, biologics, devices, and combination products
  • Advanced knowledge of drug development, post-marketing safety surveillance, and regulatory frameworks supporting product development, registration, safety monitoring, and reporting obligations
  • Working knowledge of pharmacovigilance agreements, quality agreements, inspection readiness practices, quality systems, and corrective and preventive action processes supporting global safety compliance activities
  • Demonstrated experience using safety databases and supporting technologies, preferably Argus or equivalent pharmacovigilance systems
  • Demonstrated project leadership skills with the ability to independently plan, organize, manage, and deliver large or complex projects, initiatives, and process improvements
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex compliance, quality, reconciliation, and safety-reporting issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical risk-based solutions
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work effectively across functions and influence internal and external stakeholders without direct authority
  • Ability to understand the objectives, activities, dependencies, and required contributions of internal partner functions and external business partners supporting pharmacovigilance activities
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment when evaluating compliance risks, safety-reporting challenges, inspection observations, reconciliation discrepancies, and operational issues
  • Ability to adapt effectively to evolving regulatory requirements, changing business priorities, and ambiguous operating environments
  • Ability to challenge existing practices, identify opportunities for improvement, recommend alternative approaches, and support implementation of approved process and operational changes
  • Ability to develop and deliver procedures, training materials, and operational guidance that promote compliance, consistency, and quality across partnership oversight activities
  • Ability to analyze compliance metrics, operational performance indicators, and quality trends to identify risks and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Ability to serve as a functional subject matter expert and escalation resource for partnership oversight, safety data exchange, compliance, quality, and reconciliation activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field
  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD)

Job Location

United Therapeutics has the ability to hire this role remotely within the continental United States, with a preference to candidates residing in, or willing to relocate to RTP, NC. For local candidates, this position will be located at our Durham, NC office with a hybrid schedule of 3 days in office and the option to work 2 days each week from home. In office requirements could change based on business needs.


The salary range for the Senior Global Safety Partnership Oversight Manager position is $145,500 - $190,000 and the salary range for the Associate Global Safety Partnership Oversight Director position is $167,500 - $205,000 and reflects our good-faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skills, geographic location, and business needs, as well as other factors permitted by law at the time of posting. This range may be modified in the future based on company and market factors.

At United Therapeutics, our mission and vision are one. We use our enthusiasm, creativity, and persistence to innovate for the unmet medical needs of our patients and to benefit our other stakeholders. We are bold and unconventional. We have fun, we do good.

Eligible employees may participate in the Company’s comprehensive benefits suite of programs, including medical / dental / vision / prescription coverage, employee wellness resources, savings plans (401k and ESPP), paid time off & paid parental leave benefits, disability benefits, and more. For additional information on Company benefits, please visit

United Therapeutics Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

raw.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

Through an Employer of Record (EOR), we are looking for a new, remote Flutter Developer in India to join our growing IT Team. This individual will report into our IT Team Lead. The Flutter Developer is responsible for delivering a high-quality, reliable, and user-friendly mobile experience for SupplyHouse customers across iOS and Android. This role supports the continuous improvement and innovation of the mobile application while leveraging modern technologies and AI-powered development tools to enhance efficiency, code quality, and overall productivity. Working collaboratively across teams, the developer contributes to the company's digital growth and customer satisfaction.

Role Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote from India

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 4:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time / 1:30 p.m. – 10:30 p.m. Indian Standard Time to ensure effective collaboration

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $21,380.00to $26,725 USD within a full position range of $21,380 to $32,070 USD annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain the SupplyHouse mobile application for iOS and Android using the Flutter framework, including integration with backend APIs, third-party services, and native device capabilities.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies and native device capabilities while effectively leveraging AI-powered development tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and enhance productivity.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for new requirements, existing features, and application architecture.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Development teams to deliver new features, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve the mobile customer experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing development processes and establish new workflows, tools, and best practices that increase efficiency, consistency, and software quality.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and expand automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to improve application reliability, increase test coverage, and reduce manual testing efforts.
  • Participate in code reviews, refactoring, and technical discussions to maintain high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability while following established development best practices.
  • Investigate and resolve application defects, crashes, and performance issues using debugging, analytics, and monitoring tools to maintain application stability.
  • Maintain and improve automated build and deployment processes, manage iOS and Android application releases, and address App Store and Google Play review feedback.
  • Stay current with Flutter, mobile development trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices while sharing knowledge and contributing to team development.

SCOPE AND IMPACT

This role collaborates closely with Product Management, UI/UX Design, Quality Assurance (QA), Front-End and Back-End Development, and IT leadership. The position directly contributes to the company's digital growth and customer satisfaction by delivering reliable, high-quality mobile experiences. It also supports development efficiency through AI adoption, automation, and continuous process improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of professional experience developing and maintaining Flutter applications for iOS and Android using Dart.
  • Understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, and software design principles.
  • Proficiency in effectively using AI-powered development tools for coding, debugging, testing, and documentation, including reviewing and validating AI-generated code to ensure quality, security, and maintainability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous learning skills.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git, issue tracking tools such as Jira, and development environments such as Android Studio, VS Code, or Cursor.
  • Strong knowledge of Dart, RESTful APIs, JSON, and integration with backend services and third-party SDKs.
  • Familiarity with Apple App Store and Google Play submission, testing, and review processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting mobile application issues, analyzing crash reports, and optimizing application performance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Understanding of the Agile Software Development Life Cycle and exposure to scrum projects.
  • Basic understanding of native iOS and Android development using Swift and Kotlin.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and developing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for mobile applications.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, and mobile application deployment processes.

JOB TYPE

Individual Contributor role

This role is an individual contributor with no direct reports. The position works collaboratively with Product Management, QA, Design, and Development teams and may provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and support to other developers as needed.

Why work with us: 

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options
    • Competitive Provident Fund contributions
    • Paid casual and sick leave, plus country-specific holidays
    • Mental health support and wellbeing program
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 USD work from home stipend
    • $750 USD annual professional development budget
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth – We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: !

Additional Details: 

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.   
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer, strongly values inclusion, and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. 
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. 
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.  

What is an Employer of Record (EOR)?

Through our partnership with Remote.com, a global Employer of Record (EOR), you can join SupplyHouse from home, while knowing your employment is handled compliantly and securely. Remote takes care of the behind-the-scenes details – like payroll, benefits, taxes, and local compliance – so you can focus on your work and career growth. Even though Remote manages these administrative functions, you’ll be a part of the SupplyHouse team: connected to our culture, collaborating with colleagues, and contributing to our shared success. This partnership allows us to welcome talented team members worldwide while ensuring you receive a best-in-class employee experience.

raw.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role in a nutshell:

We're looking for a hands-on technical Cyber Defense Manager to build and lead the team that keeps bad actors out of Chainguard's systems, makes sure they couldn't get far if they ever got in, and finds and removes them fast. You'll report to the Sr Director of Cyber Resiliency and lead a team of security engineers spanning four disciplines: detection engineering; incident response and digital forensics; threat intelligence and hunting; and insider risk management. This is a modern, lean, builder-first defense team — cloud-native, AI-forward, and automated by default — with a mandate to detect and respond at machine speed rather than scale by headcount. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you'll stay in the work — overseeing the agentic SecOps architecture, running investigations, and drive actionable decisions using threat intelligence — while building the team, playbooks, and detection program that let Chainguard grow without growing its exposure. We're a late-stage startup, which means priorities, tooling, and scope can shift quickly, and you'll need to be the kind of manager who's energized by that rather than worn down by it. Like every Chainguardian, you'll take the work seriously without taking yourself too seriously, and default to good intentions in how you work with others.

What you'll do:

  • Hire, lead, and grow a high-character, high-talent team of incident response engineers across detection engineering, DFIR, threat intelligence, and insider risk — coaching, performance, and career growth

Responsible for delivery, in terms of timeliness and quality, of site activation readiness within the assigned country/sites and foreseeing and mitigating any risks.

  • Review and manage collection of essential documents required for site activation/IMP release.

raw.description:
About the Role:

Loop is changing how it goes to market. We're scaling by building, not by adding headcount: connected agents, data, and workflows that find the right accounts, recognize when they're ready, and put the right action in front of the right person at the right time. We've built early foundations, and now we're ready to accelerate. We're looking for a growth-focused GTM Engineer who wants to turn that momentum into a system that scales.

Our Blended Work Environment:

At Loop, we’re intentional about the way we work so that we can do our best work. We call this our Blended Working Environment. We work from our HQ in Columbus, OH, or one of our Hub or Secluded locations, and are distributed throughout the United States, select Canadian provinces, the United Kingdom, and Australia. For this position, you are welcome to join us anywhere in the United States.

Why you may be interested in this opportunity:

  • Build with the best tools. Clay, our internal AI platform, and Claude Code are your daily tools. What you learn along the way will shape how we operate.
  • Own real outcomes. Your builds connect directly to how Loop grows.
  • Inherit momentum, not a blank page. Live agents and workflows are already running, with partners across Growth, Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and AI Ops engineering.
  • Help shape a new function. Growth is a new way of working at Loop, and you'll help define how we create pipeline.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and operate AI-powered systems across the funnel, from finding and prioritizing accounts to engaging and converting them: signals, enrichment, scoring, routing, nurture, and outreach.
  • Build agents and agentic workflows that carry volume, with human review where judgment matters. Decide where a model, deterministic logic, or a person is the right answer.
  • Go deep in Clay and Claude Code: custom skills, MCP integrations, APIs, and reusable components, all versioned and documented so others can use and extend them.
  • Make go-to-market measurable. Instrument what you build, tie it to pipeline, run experiments, and use what you learn to improve it.
  • Connect our GTM tools and data into one coherent system, building on the foundation already in place.
  • Learn how our sellers, marketers, and growth team work, and turn what you see into leverage for Loop.
  • Stay ahead of the curve: evaluate new models and tools, and recommend what we adopt, test, or retire.
  • Help the engine extend to new products and motions over time.

Your experience:

  • You have 3-5+ years of experience in either a RevOps, Marketing Ops, Demand Gen, or similar type of role.
  • You've built at depth in Clay (enrichment waterfalls, agents, workflows, signals) and know where its limits are.
  • Claude Code is part of your daily workflow, including skills, MCP, and building agents that work reliably.
  • You understand how pipeline gets created, how the funnel works, and how signals, ICP, scoring, routing, and handoffs fit together, and you can speak that language with sellers and marketers.
  • You can show systems you've built and the results they drove, and what you build is something people can rely on, with quality checks and sensible guardrails.
  • SQL, APIs, and webhooks, and comfort working in code (Python or JavaScript): you can read, debug, and review what Claude Code writes. You're comfortable working with Salesforce data.
  • You have high agency, and you are a clear communicator. You can take an open-ended problem, ground it in what stakeholders need, and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical teammates.
  • Relevant experience in RevOps, GTM or marketing ops, solutions engineering, growth, demand generation, sales development, or technical sales.
  • Bonus: Experience consolidating or replacing GTM tools, a data warehouse background, experiment design, and building internal tools or apps.
Loop Story
Commerce should feel effortless. Every product adored, every order perfect, every customer loyal for life. But reality is messier: operations get tangled, margins grow thin, and trust is fragile. That’s where Loop steps in. We create confidence where commerce fails.
We started by fixing returns and exchanges. Our mission is simple: protect margins, delight customers, and help merchants build businesses that last.

Why join Nortal

Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

Competitive USD salary.

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to collaborate with product and platform engineering teams in designing, building, and maintaining reliable, repeatable, secure, and high-performing cloud infrastructure.

The environment is primarily hosted on AWS, with a strong focus on cloud-native engineering, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and security.

You will help improve infrastructure reliability, facilitate application deployments, reduce manual operational work, and support engineering teams in delivering dependable solutions.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and deploy reliable and scalable infrastructure solutions, primarily on AWS.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab and Octopus Deploy.

  • Support containerized workloads and cloud-native infrastructure, including Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, security scanning, and observability solutions.

  • Investigate production incidents, perform root-cause analyses, and contribute to post-mortems.

  • Develop automation and scripts to reduce repetitive operational tasks and prevent recurring incidents.

  • Collaborate with product and platform engineering teams to understand infrastructure and deployment requirements.

  • Promote DevSecOps best practices and provide technical guidance to engineering teams.

  • Support incident resolution and assist support teams with complex technical issues.

  • Identify and introduce technologies and engineering practices that improve reliability and operational efficiency.

  • Provide emergency after-hours support when required.

  • Take part in Nortal's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal's growth.

What makes you a great fit

  • Degree or diploma in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 8–10 years of experience in software engineering and Infrastructure or Configuration as Code.

  • Strong expertise in AWS infrastructure design, architecture, and operations.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience designing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code solutions.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab and Octopus Deploy.

  • Strong knowledge of Git and collaborative development workflows involving multiple engineering teams.

  • Experience with containers and container orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes or Amazon EKS.

  • Experience with monitoring and log aggregation tools such as Grafana.

  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure security, automated security scanning, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and production issues, including root-cause analysis and incident prevention.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

  • Strong collaboration skills and a continuous learning mindset.

Nice to have:

  • AWS Professional-level certification.

  • Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) solutions.

  • Experience with Linux and/or Windows scripting.

  • Familiarity with Artifactory and related artifact management solutions.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving DevSecOps practices.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we've been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn't have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That's why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let's shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

raw.excerpt: About Engine Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel.
raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your MissionEngine’s Product-Led Growth (PLG) team has a clear goal: team makes sure every new customer feels taken care of from day one, so booking the next trip is never a second thought and we're looking for a Staff Data Analyst to be the data partner who steers towards it. You'll own PLG's measurement end to end, define the metrics PLG and Growth run on, build the self-service analytics partners rely on, and bring a clear point of view on where to invest and what to stop. Business travel makes this a richer problem than a typical SaaS funnel. Demand is lumpy, seasonal, and driven by need, so a quiet account isn't always a lost one.

What You'll Do

  • Own PLG's metrics. Define, build, and own the trusted metrics behind the self-serve journey, from sign-up through first booking to a second trip, tied to booking value and margin, not just volume.
  • Build self-service analytics. Create dashboards and reusable data models in dbt, Hex, and Amplitude so partners can answer everyday questions without waiting on an analyst.
  • Shape strategy. Represent data in PLG leadership, flag trends and risks early, and recommend where to invest and what to stop.
  • Set the measurement standard. Strengthen the foundation for A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and monitoring across PLG and Growth, and make sure major launches are measured against it.
  • Find new opportunities. Dig into the data to find where customers stall, which segments are under-served, and where the next growth bets should be.
  • Run analytics prioritization. Prioritize PLG's analytics work by business impact alongside your manager and product leads, and say no where needed.
  • Raise the bar. Improve how the wider team measures impact through reviews, shared playbooks, and mentoring.
  • Work across Growth. Partner with PLG product, engineering, design, and data engineering, and bring the same measurement approach to lifecycle, referrals, personalization, acquisition, and expansion.
  • Work AI-first. Use tools like Claude, Grok Bot and Cursor every day to query, build, and document faster, and help shape how the team works.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in product analytics, growth analytics, or a related role, with a track record of owning metrics for a product or growth area.
  • Expert SQL. You can take messy event data and turn it into clean, trustworthy metrics, and you know when a recurring analysis deserves to become a reusable table
  • Strong product and business sense. You turn ambiguous questions into recommendations leaders act on, tied to revenue and margin.
  • An owner's mindset. You spot problems without waiting for a ticket, move fast without cutting corners, and see the work through to impact.
  • Strong data storytelling skills, a clear communicator and the ability to influence product and business leaders.

Bonus Points

  • Strong measurement judgment. You design and read out tests and quasi-experiments, and you know when a result is real.
  • Experience building self-service analytics (Hex, Amplitude, or similar) that partners actually adopt.
  • Travel, hospitality, or T&E domain knowledge.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your analytics work.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Python, and Salesforce.

Why Join Us

  • Own the measurement behind how Engine grows its self-serve business, and directly shape the roadmap.
  • Take on a hard, interesting problem in repeat booking for business travel.
  • Build the foundation for how PLG measured, self-serve, and test, instead of inheriting a rigid process.
  • Contribute across the broader Growth team on referrals, lifecycle, personalization, acquisition, and expansion.
  • Join an AI-forward data team at a growing, profitable, and cash flow positive company.

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

Compensation
The range below is our good-faith estimate for the role. Where you land within it depends on your experience, skills, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process. If your expectations fall outside the range, please apply anyway. We'd love to talk.

Base Pay Range
$161,500—$190,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Benefits
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Equity for every employee: Every employee gets stock. As Engine grows, so does your upside.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

raw.description:
Hippo Insurance is a fast-growing InsurTech company from Silicon Valley, built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us – we use technology and data to help our customers stay ahead of problems and protect what matters most.Over the past years, we've successfully established a technical branch called SwingDev–a hippo company. More recently, we also launched our business hub, Hippo Poland, growing our local team beyond tech – including roles like this one, working directly on products built for the US market.

About the role:

Hippo works with partner insurance agencies (MGAs) across the US, helping them grow and offer better coverage to homeowners. Our Underwriting team is at the center of that – evaluating risk, making coverage decisions, and helping prevent problems before they happen.As an Underwriter, you'll manage the full underwriting lifecycle for new and renewal home insurance policies – including changes, reinstatements, and cancellations.

You'll look closely at inspection data and loss trends to recommend the right next steps, like inspections or safety measures. You'll also work closely with sales, claims, and customer support to spot patterns and close coverage gaps.

What will you do?

  • You'll underwrite new and renewal homeowners line of business in the US.
  • You'll analyze risk information and make specific recommendations for additional actions such as inspections, loss prevention, etc.
  • You'll address queries from other departments, such as claims, billing, and customer support, acting within your underwriting authority and escalating issues if necessary.
  • You'll communicate effectively with various distribution partners and leadership to resolve underwriting matters.
  • You'll recommend improvements to the underwriting process to underwrting managers and the technology counterparts.
  • You'll decide on the most challenging referrals that aren’t clearly defined by the existing guidelines where critical underwriting judgement and knowledge is key.
  • You'll observe and communicates underwriting trends and recommendations to the leadership team.

We might be a match if you…

  • Have at least 3 years of Property (P&C) Underwriting experience with demonstrated ability to interpret underwriting guidelines, policy language, inspection results, and supporting documentation, as well as the ability to think beyond individual risk decisions to broader patterns and trends.
  • Have a strong technical underwriting, analytical, and critical thinking skills, including attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Feel comfortable in a fast-paced, experimental environment and managing multiple tasks simultaneously – balancing structured underwriting discipline with flexibility to test new approaches.
  • Are curious about the "why" behind risk outcomes and feel comfortable making guideline recommendations based on evidence rather than precedent alone.
  • Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Are willing to gain state-specific/geographic knowledge to resolve unique underwriting exposures or challenges.
  • Are proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software applications.
  • Have a good command of English (both written & spoken) – at B2+ level.
  • Are able to adjust your schedule to ensure effective communication between timezones – we collaborate with colleagues from Texas & California, that's why occasional evening meetings may be necessary. Also, this role involves trips to the US.

    • You will get extra points for:

  • Familiarity with home maintenance and loss prevention.
  • Prior experience recommending process improvements or changes to underwriting guidelines is a strong signal

  • Join for a meeting with Ilya (VP, Underwriting) and Tasha (Sr. Manager, Underwriting).

raw.description:
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership across our Partner Activation and Partner Administration teams. You will help shape and deliver scalable, secure and cohesive partner-facing platform capabilities, working closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Designers and fellow Staff+ engineers so that partners can integrate with NMI efficiently and confidently.

This role balances hands-on engineering with technical strategy, with a focus on improving partner onboarding, integration experiences and the long-term health of the partner platform.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Provide technical leadership for the team, influencing architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams.
  • Own and evolve critical platform areas, including partner onboarding, developer tooling, authentication, user management and the unified partner portal.
  • Identify long-term technical risks and opportunities, and lead initiatives to improve scalability, reliability, security and maintainability.
  • Set and reinforce engineering standards, patterns and best practices across teams.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Influence

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers and Directors to align technical strategy with delivery plans and team goals.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Directors and Designers to translate product vision into technically sound, scalable solutions.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor across teams, helping resolve complex cross-team dependencies and trade-offs.
  • Drive alignment and consistency across partner-facing systems and experiences.

Hands-On Engineering & Delivery

  • Design, implement and review high-impact code, particularly in complex or high-risk areas.
  • Lead technical discovery and execution for ambiguous or strategically important initiatives.
  • Ensure solutions are well tested, observable and production-ready.
  • Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term platform health.

Mentorship & Engineering Excellence

  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, helping them grow in technical depth, system design and scope of impact.
  • Raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews, architectural guidance and knowledge sharing.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, learning and technical curiosity.

Platform Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Champion secure-by-design principles, particularly around authentication, authorisation and partner data access.
  • Work closely with SRE and platform teams to ensure systems meet reliability, availability and performance expectations.
  • Improve observability, operational readiness and incident learnings across partner-facing systems.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience developing complex software applications in a commercial environment, with demonstrated impact at the Staff or Senior Staff engineer level.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience building and maintaining large-scale systems using .NET Framework / C# (preferred) and/or PHP, with a strong understanding of object-oriented design principles and software architecture.
  • Strong experience with relational databases, particularly Microsoft SQL Server, including schema design, query optimisation, performance tuning and maintaining data integrity in production systems.
  • Proven experience designing, coding, deploying and operating cloud-based solutions hosted on AWS, with an understanding of scalability, fault tolerance, security and cost-aware design.
  • Experience designing and architecting scalable, distributed systems, with consideration for performance, reliability and long-term maintainability.
  • Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and agile development methodologies.
  • Strong knowledge of security best practices, including secure coding principles and compliance requirements (e.g. OWASP Top Ten, PCI DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA or similar).
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including HTTPS, DNS, SSL/TLS and service-to-service communication patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of design patterns and their practical application in real-world systems.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, technically sound solutions, particularly in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.
  • Demonstrated success performing code reviews and maintaining high code quality standards, including testability, readability and maintainability.
  • Proven ability to understand, debug and evolve complex existing systems, often with limited documentation and changing requirements.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through expertise, collaboration and thoughtful guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate risks, identify root causes and proactively address issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work independently while also fostering cross-team collaboration.
  • Experience working effectively with remote and globally distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment processes.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging and observability tools (e.g. Datadog, New Relic, Logz.io or similar).
  • Experience modernising or incrementally evolving legacy systems towards cloud-native architectures.
  • Background in payments, fintech or other high-availability, security-sensitive platforms.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. raw.description:
Cos'è Blox Space?

Blox Space lavora al centro dell'economia Bitcoin, in partnership con un network di oltre 70 realtà attive nel mondo del fintech, della cybersecurity e delle Freedom Technologies, impegnate nello sviluppo di infrastrutture, prodotti e servizi legati all'economia digitale, alla data protection e al futuro del denaro. Aiutiamo a connettere i talenti con l'ecosistema Bitcoin, operando come Talent Bridge tra le ambizioni di crescita dei professionisti e le opportunità offerte dal nostro network. In questo momento stiamo supportando una delle nostre partner companies nella ricerca di un Backend Developer, e se pensi di essere il profilo giusto, ci piacerebbe conoscerti.

L'azienda e il ruolo

L'azienda è uno dei nomi storici del Bitcoin applicato ai pagamenti, attiva da oltre dieci anni, con più di un milione di clienti in oltre 180 paesi e un team distribuito su più di 30 paesi. Cerchiamo un Backend Developer, da mid a senior, che costruisca le soluzioni di pagamento crypto, integri i supplier e migliori i servizi backend, puntando ad alta disponibilità, bassa latenza e scalabilità per una base di oltre un milione di persone. Non cerchiamo il curriculum perfetto, cerchiamo la testa giusta. Cerchiamo chi è forte su backend e pagamenti, prende decisioni tecniche e fa crescere i più junior. Le responsabilità di un Backend Developer in questo contesto possono spaziare dallo sviluppo e dalla manutenzione dei sistemi backend di pagamento crypto in Node.js e TypeScript, al tenere in piedi il servizio esistente migliorando sistemi e processi, dall'implementazione di nuove integrazioni con supplier e terze parti alla collaborazione con i team cross-funzionali di backend, frontend e design.

Le skill che fanno la differenza

  • 5+ anni di esperienza backend, principalmente in Node.js e TypeScript e/o Python, con MongoDB e Typesense.
  • Esperienza su piattaforme e-commerce o sistemi simili: sai cosa vuol dire reggere volumi e criticità reali.
  • Capacità di prendere decisioni tecniche e di fare mentoring agli sviluppatori più junior.
  • Ottimo inglese: il team è internazionale e distribuito.
  • Interesse per come l'AI sta cambiando il modo di programmare e apertura ai workflow AI-augmented.
  • Sono VERY Nice to Have: esperienza con tecnologie di search come Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Lucene o Solr, per la ricerca interna della piattaforma e-commerce e dei tool interni.

Ti manca qualcosa rispetto a quello che hai letto? Candidati comunque: siamo a caccia di game-changer, non di checklist da spuntare!

Work arrangements

Il ruolo ha come sede preferenziale l'hub di Blox Space a Torino, ma è aperto anche a candidature in remoto. L'azienda è remote-first dal primo giorno, con un team distribuito su più di 30 paesi e ritrovi periodici di persona. Se lo desideri puoi essere pagato in crypto.

Unisciti all'ecosistema con Blox Space!

Se vuoi costruire l'infrastruttura di pagamento che fa girare un prodotto Bitcoin usato da oltre un milione di persone, questa è l'opportunità che stavi aspettando: lavorare con una delle nostre partner companies significa entrare in un team innovativo e in forte crescita, al centro di un ecosistema dove circolano idee, competenze e progetti ad alta intensità tecnica. È un ambiente dove si costruisce, si testa, si discute e si migliora ogni giorno.

Summary
As organizations accelerate their adoption of Agentic AI capabilities, the demand for robust data management and governance solutions is becoming increasingly critical. Atlas Data Science is seeking an L2/L3 Software Engineer to help build a central metadata hub that streamlines discovery, access, use, and sharing of diverse data types across an expanding ecosystem of suppliers and consumers. By orchestrating the full data lifecycle—from receipt to metadata capture and enrichment to discovery and dissemination—we aim to deliver a new-to-market data management and governance product that is foundational to enable agentic at scale.

Duties and Responsibilities Build the services and interfaces that control what AI agents can access and make their actions reviewable. You’ll work across backend APIs, and audit pipelines with guidance from other engineers on architecture and security design.

What You’ll Do
• Build API endpoints and services in TypeScript using Node.js and NestJS, and supporting tools in Python
• Implement authentication and authorization flows within an established security architecture.
• Build audit pipelines that capture attempted agent tool calls, authorization decisions and execution outcomes.
• Work with senior and platform engineers to deliver features, diagnose production issues and improve reliability.
• Document implementation decisions and communicate progress and risks clearly.

Required Competencies
• About 3 to 5 years building production software.
• Strong TypeScript or Python, and working knowledge of the other.
• Experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL and automated testing.
• Comfort with Docker, Git and a CI pipeline.
• Care about correctness: you check what a test actually covers before calling it done.
• Clear written communication in tickets, code reviews and technical documentation.

Bonus Points
• Experience with NVIDIA OpenShell or sandboxed execution environments.
• Experience building tools for or with AI agents and LLMs.
• Familiarity with identity and authentication concepts such as OIDC and token handling.
• Experience with structured logging, tracing, audit trails or event processing
• Experience building tools for or with AI agents and LLMs.

Other Requirements

• US Citizen.

  • Remote first, but ability to work CST or EST hours. Some ad-hoc travel for team offsites.

    Interview Process
    1. Intro to Atlas/ Candidate Q&A: 15 minutes with VP of Finance and Ops and a member of our Engineering team
    2. Panel Interview with Technical Leadership: 45 minutes
    3. Technical Test: 45 minutes

4. Meet the CEO: 30 minutes

raw.description:
Meet True Vet
At True Vet Solutions, we believe no veteran should have to fight alone for what they already earned.
Every day in America, veterans walk away from disability benefits they qualify for, not because they don't deserve them, but because the system meant to serve them is slow, confusing, and built to wear people down. We exist to change that. We stand between the veteran and the system, and we do not stop until they receive every benefit they earned.
We are a team of high-empathy, high-standards people doing work that actually matters. We answer the call when someone who served is at the end of their rope, and we turn it into an outcome that changes their life. The proof is in what our clients live:
  • Tens of thousands of veterans represented
  • $350M+ in lifetime benefits secured for the people who served
  • 4.9-star client rating across 634 reviews
Where we're going. We are not building a small shop that helps a few hundred veterans a year. There are millions of veterans in this country leaving earned benefits on the table, and we intend to reach them. We are building the most trusted veteran advocacy organization in America, and we are building it fast. If you are looking for a ceiling, this is the wrong place. If you are looking for a mission big enough to spend a career on, and a company moving fast enough for you to grow into the leader you're capable of becoming, keep reading.
The mission of this role
As an Intake Specialist, hours of work would be either 9am - 5pm or 12pm - 8pm eastern standard time, you will be responsible for supporting and assisting veterans in navigating the world of VA Disabilities Claims. You will work directly with veterans to assess their needs, strategize the most beneficial route to take for their claim, and assist them in initiating the claim-building process. Your role will be crucial in ensuring our veterans receive the support and care they deserve.
What you'll own
  • Conduct intake assessments with veterans to determine their needs and goals
  • Develop personalized strategy plans for each veteran based on their unique circumstances
  • Provide advocacy and support to veterans in accessing necessary documents for their claim
  • Assist veterans in completing necessary paperwork and applications for benefits
  • Collaborate with other organizations and agencies to ensure veterans receive
comprehensive support
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of services provided to veterans

Requirements
  • Prior experience working with Veterans or familiarity with Veterans preferred.
  • Previous sales experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of Veteran benefits and resources preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills using metrics to make sound decisions.
  • Process improvement mindset. Strong Communication skills (both written and verbal)
What we offer you
  • Daily coaching and real skill development, you will be sharper in six months than you have ever been
  • A clear path to grow; we promote from within and invest in the people who invest in the mission
  • A team that has your back, and a standard worth being held to
  • Work that lets you end the day knowing you changed the life of someone who served
Benefits
  • Remote-first work, from anywhere in the USA
  • Employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off and company-wide holidays
  • Hospitality experiences and team gatherings that make remote feel connected
Our Core Values
Our values are the heart of this company. The right person for any role here recognizes themselves in each of them.
Empathy, Without Exception. Every veteran is a person who served, not a case number. We lead with understanding and we hold that standard on the hardest days, in the longest calls, with the most frustrated client. Empathy is the one thing we will never trade away.
Remarkable Character. We do right by veterans when no one is watching. We tell each other hard truths with care, accept them with humility, and keep our words and our actions pointed at the same goal.
Relentless Advocacy. We fight for every benefit a veteran earned, and we do not quit when the system pushes back. It is us against the issue, never us against the veteran, and never each other.
Competitive Greatness. We hold ourselves to an elite standard because the people who served deserve elite representation. We compound small improvements into outsized results, and we build each other into leaders along the way.
How to apply
If this is the mission you've been looking for, apply now. Tell us why this work matters to you, we read every one.
True Vet Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for character and capability, and we welcome applicants of every background. Veterans and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

As a Senior Proposal Associate - Pricing, you’ll partner across Business Development, Clinical, Operational, and subject matter expert teams to develop high-quality pricing solutions aligned with each proposal’s operational strategy and technical approach.


You’ll take ownership of pricing activities for RFPs and supporting materials across single or multiple-service and regional clinical development protocols and programs. Werde der Closer von Roemer Capital und hilf Gründern und Geschäftsführern, die richtigen Investoren zu finden.

Roemer Capital ist eine Investmentboutique aus Düsseldorf. Wir begleiten Tech-Startups und Technologieunternehmen im DACH-Raum bei Finanzierungsrunden, Unternehmensverkäufen und CFO-Themen: von der Finanzierungsstrategie über alle Unterlagen bis zum Abschluss mit Investoren.

Unsere Setter qualifizieren Leads aus LinkedIn, Outreach und Inbound und buchen Strategiegespräche. Für diese Gespräche suchen wir einen Closer, der hochwertige Beratungsmandate abschließt.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst qualifizierte Strategiegespräche per Video mit Gründern, Geschäftsführern und CFOs.

  • Du analysierst Ziel, Kapitalbedarf und Ausgangslage und stellst das passende Angebot vor (Beratungsmandate mit monatlichem Honorar und Erfolgshonorar).

  • Du führst die Verhandlung bis zur digitalen Unterschrift und dokumentierst alles sauber im CRM (Close).

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Settern zusammen und gibst Feedback zur Qualität der Termine.

  • Du entwickelst Closing-Leitfaden und Einwandbehandlung mit uns weiter und kennst deine Zahlen: Abschlussquote, Umsatz, Abschlüsse pro Monat.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Closing von High-Ticket-Angeboten im B2B (Beratung, Software oder Dienstleistung), idealerweise mit Auftragswerten ab 5.000 €.

  • Nachweisbare Ergebnisse: Abschlussquote, Umsatz und Anzahl der Abschlüsse.

  • Souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Gründern und C-Level, sicher in Videocalls.

  • Interesse an Finanzierung, Startups und M&A. Vorwissen ist ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Verlässlichkeit.

Benefits

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Stunden), unbefristet.

  • Fixum plus attraktive Provision je abgeschlossenem Mandat.

  • Qualifizierte Termine durch unser Setter-Team: Du konzentrierst dich aufs Closing.

  • Ein hochwertiges Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Kunden.

  • Klarer Karrierepfad bis zum Teamlead Closing.

  • Remote-first mit klaren Zielen statt Präsenzpflicht.

  • Zugang zu Sales-Trainings (u. a. Baulig „Verkaufen mit System“).

So läuft deine Bewerbung

  1. Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“. Lebenslauf reicht, deine Zahlen (Abschlussquote, Umsatz) gern direkt dazu.

  3. Interview per Video mit unserem Geschäftsführer Lucas Roemer (45 Minuten).

  4. Angebot.

Du hörst in der Regel innerhalb von 3 Werktagen von uns.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich im Erstgespräch kennenzulernen!
