raw.description:
À propos de ShareGate

ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.

Il offre l’approche la plus simple, fiable et abordable pour migrer les données d’entreprise sur Microsoft 365.

Que ce soit Google Workspace, les disques réseaux, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, ou d’un tenant à l’autre, ShareGate s’en occupe et offre la paix d’esprit. D’une transition vers le cloud à l’intégration d’une nouvelle entreprise, il garde les choses vraiment simples.

ShareGate est aussi l’outil de prédilection pour garder le contrôle des données une fois que la migration est complétée. Ses fonctionnalités de gouvernance permettent d'évaluer rapidement les environnements M365, détecter les problèmes et apporter les correctifs nécessaires, pour que tout reste ordonné, sécurisé et optimisé. Il aide à mettre en place la fondation pour déployer avec confiance l’assistant d'IA de Microsoft.

ShareGate est développé par Workleap Technologies, une entreprise de logiciels basée à Montréal.

Ton rôle

ShareGate évolue vers des expériences plus modernes, intuitives et fiables, et tu vas aider à mener ce virage. Tu vas bâtir et faire évoluer notre frontend React et TypeScript, influencer l'architecture et l'orientation technique, et travailler avec les équipes produit et design pour régler des problèmes complexes qui comptent pour les client.e.s. Tu vas aussi élever la barre technique par ton jugement, des pratiques modernes et le développement assisté par l'IA au quotidien.

Ton impact :

  • Livrer des fonctionnalités de grande qualité en React et TypeScript qui offrent aux client.e.s de ShareGate des expériences intuitives, rapides et fiables.
  • Façonner l'architecture frontend (composants réutilisables, structure du code, tests, performance) pour que le produit reste facile à maintenir et que chaque nouvelle fonctionnalité sorte plus vite que la précédente.
  • Prendre en charge des initiatives, de la conception technique à la livraison, avec le produit et le design, pour régler de vrais problèmes client.
  • Améliorer en continu la qualité, l'accessibilité, la performance et l'expérience utilisateur, et réduire la dette technique pour que le produit évolue de façon durable.
  • Utiliser chaque jour des outils de développement assisté par l'IA, comme Claude Code, pour livrer plus vite, rehausser la qualité du code et faire progresser les pratiques d'IA de l'équipe.
  • Élever la barre technique de l'équipe par du mentorat, du partage de connaissances et des revues de code qui font grandir les autres.

Ton équipe

Tu vas faire partie de l'équipe ShareGate Migrate, aux côtés de développeur.euse.s d'expérience, d'un.e gestionnaire de produit et d'un.e designer de produit. Tu peux aussi compter sur des expert.e.s de niveau staff et d'autres équipes pour le soutien technique. Dans les 6 à 12 prochains mois, on va améliorer et étendre notre frontend React, peaufiner l'expérience utilisateur et poser les bases techniques de la prochaine étape de ShareGate. On valorise l'autonomie, le sens des responsabilités et la communication ouverte : les décisions techniques se prennent ensemble, les connaissances se partagent et le développement assisté par l'IA fait partie de notre façon de livrer. Notre stack : React et TypeScript, C#/.NET, Azure, API Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, GitHub, tests automatisés et CI/CD.

Ce que tu apportes

  • 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en développement logiciel, idéalement dans un environnement orienté produit ;
  • Une solide expertise en React et TypeScript, avec une bonne maîtrise de l'architecture frontend, de la conception de composants, de la performance et des tests automatisés ;
  • Un jugement technique solide et l'envie de bâtir : tu prends les choses en main, tu décides avec l'information que tu as et tu continues d'élever la barre, côté produit comme côté pratiques d'ingénierie ;
  • Une utilisation quotidienne d'outils d'IA (p. ex. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) en développement logiciel, bien ancrée dans tes habitudes ;
  • Une communication claire et directe, y compris la capacité de remettre en question des décisions produit de façon constructive ;

Who Are We?

1Nebula is a next-generation SaaS Technology Business focused on providing businesses with cloud & technology expense management services and tools to accelerate their cloud journey.

We hire amazing people from across South Africa, making our diverse group of team members, called N48Xers, a force to be reckoned with.

Learn more about our people brand by watching our culture videos:


Job Opportunity at 1Nebula:

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team. In this role you will turn data into clear, meaningful dashboards and insights, for internal teams and for our clients. You will focus mainly on the front end: understanding what stakeholders need, deciding how best to visualise it, and building dashboards that give the full picture. You’ll work closely with our data engineering and development teams, and you’ll help build the dashboards inside OneView, our client-facing application.

What You will do within this role (Your key responsibilities):

Dashboards & Visualisation:

  • Design, build and maintain dashboards using Power BI or similar visualisation tools

Data & Collaboration:

raw.excerpt: Wir möchten die Anlaufstelle für Google Ads & Web Analytics für E-Commerce Unternehmen mit großem Produktsortiment im DACH-Raum werden.
raw.description:
Wir möchten die Anlaufstelle für Google Ads & Web Analytics für E-Commerce Unternehmen mit großem Produktsortiment im DACH-Raum werden. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass viele Online-Shops noch nicht ihr volles Potenzial aufgrund von schlechter Betreuung ausschöpfen. Wir wollen das ändern.

Dabei legen wir bei uns einen großen Wert auf persönliche Entwicklung, operative und strategische Erstklassigkeit sowie Transparenz.

Wir wollen, dass sich alle unsere Teammitglieder fachlich als auch menschlich weiterentwickeln und so für außergewöhnlich gute Kundenergebnisse sorgen.

Über uns

Wir sitzen im wunderschönen Hamburg direkt am Jungfernstieg und unser Team besteht derzeit aus 7 Personen verteilt in Deutschland. Wir möchten als Unternehmen personell weiter wachsen, um noch mehr spannende Kunden bedienen zu können.

Wir arbeiten vollständig Remote (mit Möglichkeit auf einen Büroplatz in Hamburg), treffen uns aber regelmäßig persönlich auf unseren Quartalsmeetings oder Konferenzen zum gemeinsamen Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten.

Wir legen viel Wert auf strategische Beratung erstklassige operative Ausführung. Das heißt, Du findest hier keine Massenabfertigung sondern kannst Dir wirklich Zeit nehmen, um das Meiste aus Deinen Kunden rauszuholen.

Aufgaben

Als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bist du dafür verantwortlich, die besten Ergebnisse für Deine Kunden zu erfüllen - alleine und gemeinsam im Zweier-Projektteam.

  • Du übernimmst ein Portfolio mit bestehenden E-Commerce Kunden (4-6 stellige monatliche Budgets) und betreust diese operativ und auch strategisch bei der Weiterentwicklung. Du übernimmst dabei das Aufsetzen, die Steuerung, Messung und Optimierung der Google Ads (& Microsoft Ads) Kampagnen und optimalerweise auch Web Analytics Maßnahmen und sorgst somit maßgeblich für den Erfolg des Kunden.

  • Du konzipierst und planst eigenständig hochprofitable Performance-Marketing-Strategien: Dabei nutzt du deine Kenntnisse von Google Search / Shopping / PMAX/ Demand Gen / YouTube / Display und sorgst somit für die effiziente Steigerung der Umsätze deiner Kunden.

  • Du hältst eigenständig oder bei Großkunden gemeinsam mit Sergej (Geschäftsführer) oder einem der Unit Leads SEA-Team, regelmäßige Termine zur Abstimmung mit den Kunden und zeigst ihnen neue Möglichkeiten fürs Wachstum.

  • Du übernimmst die Analyse und Auswertung der Kampagnen und kannst anhand der Reportings Empfehlungen ableiten.

  • Du beobachtest Marktentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Chancen zum weiteren Ausbau der Performance-Aktivitäten.

  • Du analysierst die Unternehmensstruktur Deiner Kunden, verstehst die wirtschaftlich relevanten Kennzahlen und bildest darauf aufbauend performance-orientierte Lösungen ab.

  • Es ist wichtig, dass du eigenständig arbeiten kannst, dir die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Kunden Spaß macht und du gerne ins Detail gehst.

  • Du bist in der Lage Dir immer wieder das neueste Wissen anzueignen und bei Deinen Kundenprokten einzusetzen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld - im Bereich Performance-Marketing mit dem Schwerpunkt SEA bzw. Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMAX etc. Kampagnen).

  • Erfahrener Umgang mit fünf- bis sechsstelligen Budgets bei Google Ads. Zusätzlich praktische Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center, Google Analytics. Bonus wäre Erfahrung mit Looker Studio und dem Google Tag Manager.

  • Praktische Erfahrung im eigenständigen Kundenkontakt und Kundenentwicklung durch vorherige Positionen.

  • Kundenorientierte, selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsorientierung.

  • Die Analyse und Auswertung von Daten gehört zu Deinen größten Stärken. Du wertest Deine Kampagnen aus und triffst auf Basis Deiner Analyse die nächste Entscheidung.

  • Dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten, Deine souveräne Art sowie starke Kommunikations Skills zeichnen Dich aus und machen Dich unheimlich erfolgreich im Kundenkontakt/ in der Kundenbetreuung.

  • Nice to have: Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftliches Studium und/ oder vergleichbarer Studiengang/ Ausbildung.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift.

  • Fester Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

Benefits

  • Erlebe eine wachsende Agentur hautnah und nutze die Möglichkeit, direkt an Entscheidungen beteiligt zu sein und aktiv mitzugestalten, anstatt in eingestaubten Strukturen gefangen zu sein.

  • Steile Lernkurve durch Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im SEA und Web Analytics und jährlicher Besuch von Fachmessen oder Schulungen.

  • Lange Kundenbindung ermöglicht es, sich sehr tief mit unseren Kunden und ihren Prozessen auseinander zu setzen, um gemeinsam mit den Kunden zu wachsen.

  • Karriereperspektiven und die Möglichkeit an der Gestaltung der Agenturprozesse teilzuhaben.

  • Flache Hierarchien: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sergej, dem Geschäftsführer und Aufstiegschancen.

  • Zugriff auf unser sehr umfangreiches internes Wissens Wiki.

  • Quartalsweise mehrtätige Meetings mit dem ganzen Team für gemeinsames Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten.

  • Ausstattung mit Apple MacBook, großem Bildschirm und hochwertigen Peripheriegeräte.

  • Home Office (innerhalb Deutschlands) mit Option ins Büro in Hamburg zu kommen. Zusätzlich die Möglichkeit vereinzelnt aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten - 39h Wochenarbeitszeit mit Kernarbeitszeiten von Mo. - Fr. 10:00 - 15:00.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub + 1 Urlaubstag am Geburtstag + Halber Tag am 24. & 31.12 = Bis zu 32 Urlaubstage.

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.

Du solltest Lust haben, in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten und Prozesse mitzugestalten, damit wir als Agentur weiter wachsen können. Wir wünschen uns auch, dass Du Deine Expertise einbringst und uns als Team weiter entwickelst. Der interne Austausch ist uns sehr wichtig, denn nur so ist ein gesundes menschliches und fachliches Wachstum möglich.

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder Dein gepflegtes LinkedIn Profil zu und erzähle uns über Deine bisherigen praktischen Erfahrungen im SEA als auch in der Kundenbetreuung. Wir freuen uns sehr auf Deine Bewerbung!

  • Patient Communication: Facilitate communication between patients and healthcare providers, including relaying messages, scheduling follow-up appointments, and addressing inquiries.

Description

About Intuition Robotics

Intuition Robotics is on a mission to empower older adults to live happier, healthier, and more independent lives at home. Our award-winning AI companion, ElliQ®, was designed specifically for older adults to support aging in place by promoting social interaction, proactive care, and well-being.

Founded in 2016 and backed by world-class investors including Toyota Ventures and Samsung NEXT we operate globally from Tel Aviv, San Francisco, Athens and Tokyo. We're now expanding our team in Japan, a society with one of the largest aging populations in the world, and we're looking for a talented, passionate Character Content Writer to shape the personality of EllIQ, adapt and launch the very first version of ElliQ for Japanese older adults.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Character Script Writer to join our Japanese team, you will be responsible for shaping ElliQ’s personality and presence for the Japanese market.

You will define how ElliQ speaks, expresses empathy, and builds trust - creating a character that feels warm, respectful, and deeply aligned with Japanese culture and older adult values. Your work will influence ElliQ’s tone, conversational style, emotional expressions, and character behavior.

You will collaborate closely with the UX, Product, and R&D teams to translate complex interactions into intuitive, conversational experiences. You will create a character that feels less like a device and more like a natural, trusted presence in the home.

Key Responsibilities

  • Script Conversational Interactions: Ideate, design, and script engaging conversational interactions for human-robotic communication.
  • Own the Japanese ElliQ Character: write and create personality that will fit to the Japanese Older adults.
  • Expand and refine ElliQ’s unique character to enhance its expressiveness and relatability.
  • Leverage LLM Technologies: Utilize the latest advancements in language models to craft natural and meaningful conversations.
  • User Research: Conduct research on real user experiences and interactions to inform and refine conversation designs.

Requirements

  • Experience: Understanding digital content design, script writing, or content writing . This position is relevant for graduates - Copywriting/ Japanese and English Literature/ Journalism and ect.

raw.excerpt: Über Neolymp NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018 mit der Vision, Home-Training smarter, hochwertiger und zugänglicher zu machen.
raw.description:
Über Neolymp

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018 mit der Vision, Home-Training smarter, hochwertiger und zugänglicher zu machen. Wir entwickeln Trainingsgeräte, die Funktion, Design und Motivation verbinden, von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking Pads. Unser Team aus mittlerweile über 10 engagierten Menschen arbeitet vollständig remote, verteilt über ganz Deutschland. Wir setzen auf Eigenverantwortung, Effizienz und klare Strukturen.

Warum diese Rolle

Du prägst das Kundenerlebnis: Jede Anfrage, jede Reklamation und jede Bewertung läuft über dein Team. Du entscheidest, wie NEOLYMP sich für Kund:innen nach dem Kauf anfühlt.
Führung mit echtem Hebel: Du leitest unser Support-Team, setzt Prioritäten und entwickelst die Menschen darin weiter.
Prozesse statt Feuerwehr: Du baust Strukturen, Wissensdatenbanken und Automatisierungen auf, damit dein Team weniger manuell arbeitet und mehr löst.
Dein Feedback wirkt im ganzen Unternehmen: Was im Support ankommt, fließt bei uns direkt in Produktentwicklung, Shop, Marketing und Logistik zurück.
Wachstum mitgestalten: Wir wollen in den nächsten Jahren deutlich wachsen. Du baust den Kundenservice so auf, dass er diesen Weg trägt.

Deine Aufgaben

Teamführung

Du führst unser Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, planst Kapazitäten und Erreichbarkeit und gibst klares Feedback.

Du arbeitest neue Teammitglieder ein und entwickelst dein Team gezielt weiter.

Du packst selbst mit an, wenn das Anfragevolumen steigt, etwa rund um Sales-Events wie Black Friday.

Operatives Support-Management

Du verantwortest den Kundenservice über alle Kanäle: E-Mail, Telefon, Onlineshop und Marktplätze wie Amazon oder Otto.

Du steuerst Reklamationen, Retouren, Ersatzteil- und Lieferanfragen und löst Eskalationen.

Du stellst sicher, dass die Kundenkommunikation die Richtlinien der Marktplätze, insbesondere von Amazon, einhält.

Prozesse & Qualität

Du definierst Support-KPIs wie Antwortzeit, Lösungsquote und Kundenzufriedenheit und machst sie transparent.

Du baust Textbausteine, Wissensdatenbank und Self-Service-Angebote (FAQs, Anleitungen) auf und aus.

Du treibst Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI im Support voran: Workflows, Trigger, KI-gestützte Erstantworten und Ticket-Klassifizierung.

Schnittstellen

Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Support strukturiert an Produktentwicklung, Shop, Marketing und Marktplatz-Team weiter, etwa zu wiederkehrenden Produktfragen oder Lieferverzögerungen.

Du stimmst dich mit Logistik und Fulfillment ab, wenn Bestellungen hängen oder Retourenprozesse angepasst werden.

Du unterstützt Operations punktuell, etwa bei der Wareneingangskontrolle, der Qualitätsprüfung von Retouren und der Ersatzteil-Bestandsplanung – so fließen Reklamationsmuster direkt in Einkauf und Produktentwicklung zurück.

Was du mitbringst

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise im E-Commerce und D2C.

Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Support-Team oder Teile davon fachlich und disziplinarisch geleitet.

Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Ticketsystemen und Helpdesk-Tools: Routing, SLAs, Makros und Tagging kennst du nicht nur als Nutzer, sondern konfigurierst sie selbst.

Du hast Support-Prozesse bereits automatisiert – Workflows, Trigger, Schnittstellen zu Shop- und Logistiksystemen – und weißt, wo Automatisierung hilft und wo sie Kund:innen nervt.

Du setzt KI-Tools im Support praktisch ein, etwa für Erstantworten, Ticket-Klassifizierung oder den Aufbau der Wissensdatenbank, und entwickelst das für dein Team weiter.

Erfahrung im Marktplatz-Support, insbesondere mit Amazon Seller Central und dessen Kommunikations- und Reaktionszeit-Regeln.

Du arbeitest datengetrieben: Antwortzeit, Lösungsquote, Kundenzufriedenheit und Ticketvolumen sind für dich Steuerungsgrößen, aus denen du Maßnahmen ableitest.

Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

Du behältst auch bei hohem Anfragevolumen den Überblick und setzt klare Prioritäten.

Du denkst in Prozessen: Du löst nicht nur den Einzelfall, sondern die Ursache dahinter.

Du kommunizierst klar und freundlich, mit Kund:innen genauso wie mit Kolleg:innen.

Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung – auch im Remote-Setup arbeitest du strukturiert und selbstständig.

Nice to have

Erfahrung mit Otto oder weiteren Marktplätzen.

Erfahrung mit Shop-Backends wie Shopify.

Erfahrung im Aufbau von Help-Center- und Self-Service-Angeboten.

Erfahrung in Operations, Logistik oder Retourenmanagement.

Erfahrung im Fitness-, Sport- oder Health-Bereich.

Benefits

Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen.
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of E-Commerce und arbeitest mit eigener Personalverantwortung selbstständig und frei.
Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wenn wir damit dein Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Job Summary

Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, Axiom, with the spin planned for Q1 2027. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support Axiom, a company focused on critical digital infrastructure and delivering end-to-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission-critical applications.

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Solutions Architect, EMEA Modular, based remote in Ireland, to visit customer sites in Europe.

Reporting to the Global Modular Product Line Director, the Solutions Architect, EMEA Modular role serves as the Modular product line's technical lead for EMEA, defining the technical offer for power pods, skids, e-houses, and IT pods. This role is the customer's technical partner from first conversation to engineering handoff, and bridges Sales, Sales Operations, Engineering, and Operations to ensure solutions are technically sound, buildable, and commercially successful.

Help shape the future of music teaching in London

Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair, Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London.

We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice.

You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week.

About Matchspace Music

Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place.

Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London.

What you’ll do

As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll:

  • Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks.

  • Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice.

  • Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team.

  • Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch.

  • Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community.

This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week, starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments.

What you’ll bring

We’d like to hear from musicians who:

  • Are actively connected to London’s music community.

  • Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works.

  • Enjoy meeting people and feel comfortable starting conversations.

  • Can share thoughtful, constructive feedback.

  • Want to help shape how we launch in London.

  • Can commit four hours per week for six months.

A student or recent graduate of a London conservatoire, we’re starting conversations at RAM, RCM, Guildhall and Trinity Laban, and welcome ambitious musicians from across the city, in any discipline: strings, piano, voice, jazz, composition and beyond.

What you’ll get

  • Paid participation: £25 per hour.

  • Flexible scheduling around your studies or other commitments.

  • Direct access to the founder and opportunities to contribute to product discussions.

  • A voice in the UK launch, helping us understand and respond to musicians’ needs.

  • Lasting recognition as a founding ambassador.

  • A dedicated contact: Fanny Chelle, musician, teacher and Customer Success Specialist, who will welcome you and guide you through the programme.

Overview

At Eagle Foods we are builders. We are builders of brands, categories, and people. Eagle Foods enjoys a rich heritage with brands that have proven category leadership for more than 150 years. Eagle is a diversified food company producing and marketing sweetened condensed and evaporated milk, snacks and convenient meal solutions products. As a company, Eagle Foods is passionate about fostering an entrepreneurial spirit that boldly builds better people and better brands while focusing on the positive impact our company, our products and our people have on the world. Eagle Foods has a bold family of brands that consumers have come to rely on for decades, including Eagle Brand® Sweetened Condensed Milk and Evaporated Milk, Magnolia® Sweetened Condensed Milk, PET® Milk, Popcorn Indiana, Cretors Popcorn, Helper and Suddenly Salad. Eagle Foods products are marketed and distributed across all U.S. retail channels, including grocery stores, club stores and mass-merchandisers, as well as foodservice and export, U.S. military, and private label business.

Responsibilities

Job Description Summary

The Brand Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day management of a key brand portfolio. This role will drive marketing strategies that support business growth through brand development, innovation, consumer engagement, and performance optimization. The position partners cross-functionally to execute initiatives that strengthen brand performance and achieve company objectives. This role reports to the Senior Director, Brand Marketing.

Essential Functions

  • Be the point of contact for the milk brands, bringing strategic and creative thinking that will drive brand growth across marketing, innovation, pricing, distribution, and cost savings initiatives. Maintain continuous awareness of cultural trends, consumer & marketplace trends, and media channels to bring forth new ideas to test/implement.
  • Develop and execute annual marketing plan, KPIs, and budget allocation. Partner with Integrated Marketing and Insights teams to continuously evaluate ROI on overall budget expenditures and provide recommendations for go-forward plans.
  • Lead innovation pipeline development and product execution through Stage Gate. Manage weekly team meetings, follow ups, and problem-solving initiatives to ensure successful, on-time launch. Be the go-to team lead on strategic fit and tactical details.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional team members (Integrated Marketing, Sales Strategy & Planning, Insights, Revenue Growth, Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Finance) to drive go-to-market strategy, brand growth initiatives, and product launches. This includes leading the development of selling stories and marketing materials that translate our portfolio and commercial strategies into actionable resources that help enable our customer teams to sell effectively.
  • Coordinate and execute retail business-related marketing efforts. Including but not limited to:
    • Maintain current business, including management of product, specification, and packaging changes.
    • Address customer and Sales inquiries and partner in customer product presentations.
    • Assist demand planning in monthly forecasting by providing view of marketing activities and expected lift.
    • Manage website updates and data analytics.
  • Provide regular competitive review and business performance updates.
    • Track, evaluate, and report on competitive brand positioning, pricing, marketing and social/digital tactics, performance.
    • Conduct product reviews with key stakeholders including coordinating product panels, procurement of samples, documents, and review protocol.
    • Analyze milk business on a regular basis to understand shifts and due-to in order to actively manage brand deliverables and future initiatives.
  • Understand category and brand dynamics to recommend necessary shifts in price-pack architecture, SKU line up, and distribution focuses (branded, PL, food service).
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Desired Traits

  • Business Owner – Thorough understand of business dynamics and ability to define the destination, motivate others to help deliver against goals, provide strategic POVs, and drive accountability to execute with excellence in an entrepreneurial environment.
  • Team Player – Collaborative approach with a “We” vs. “Me” mentality so that we collectively win as a team.
  • Self-Starter – Ability to identify needs and hold self accountable to address. Brings ideas and solutions to the team.
  • Growth Mindset – A “yes, and” person that stays curious while seeking out and recognizing opportunities to improve the company, brand, team, and self.
  • Detail-Oriented – While leading strategically, also masterfully manages the details, from project management to data analytics to timeline adherence.
  • Agility – A multi-tasker and problem solver that can lead nimbly through ambiguity and complexity while prioritizing efforts that will deliver the greatest impact.

Eagle Foods will provide reasonable accommodations to allow an employee to perform the essential functions of the job.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field (MBA strongly preferred).
  • 4+ years of classic CPG Brand Management experience; Food or Beverage experience preferred.
  • Understanding of business fundamentals and ability to use that skillset to convert insights into to sustainable strategies and action plans for growth.
  • Strong financial and strategic acumen, analytical abilities, and communication skills.
  • Capable of independent decision making and influencing others.
  • Project management skills and the ability to prioritize and multitask against several complex projects at a time.
  • Familiarity with syndicated data systems (Nielsen, Consumer Household Panel, etc.), managing and leveraging primary consumer research and manipulating multiple data sources to generate business insights and actions.
  • Computer proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Additional Information

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing tasks and responsibilities of the job.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach above shoulders, taste and/or smell, or talk and/or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision, peripheral vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Working Conditions: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The employee occasionally works in proximity to fumes or air-borne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, and in non-weather related extreme cold. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Eagle Foods is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Eagle Foods also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. raw.excerpt: About HeyGen At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all.
raw.description:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at . Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

The Role

We are hiring a Community Manager to build and grow HeyGen's in-person community across the US East region. This is a long-term, part-time contract (15-25 hours per week) with frequent travel. You will lead workshops for creators and small businesses, run HeyGen's presence at tradeshows and conferences, and recruit and activate local ambassadors and partners. This is an independent, builder role. You will own the region end to end: set the plan, open doors, and do the hands-on work yourself, whether that is leading a room of small business owners, staffing a booth, or coaching an ambassador through their first event. Within 12 months, success looks like US tradeshows that run smoothly, on time, and on budget, an active group of ambassadors and partners hosting their own events, a regular cadence of workshops across key East Coast cities, and measurable pipeline and user activation coming out of all of it. Over time, you will build a community engine that grows beyond what you can run alone.

What You'll Do

Lead hands-on workshops and meetups - You will run HeyGen workshops and meetups for creators, partners' audiences, and small businesses, co-host events with partners, and support ambassador-led events. You will keep content current as HeyGen ships and follow up with attendees to drive activation.

Own tradeshow and conference logistics - You will manage assigned tradeshows and conferences end to end, from booth registration and shipping to vendors, staffing, and teardown. Tradeshow support may span the entire US, not only the East Coast.

Staff the booth - You will run demos, capture leads, and route attendees to the right team.

Organize side events - You will plan dinners, happy hours, and pop-up workshops around major events, and report on results.

Build and run the regional community plan - You will set a community plan for the US East region that aligns with HeyGen's global direction.

Recruit and activate ambassadors - You will find, enable, and support local ambassadors who educate users, host events, and represent HeyGen.

Open local partnerships - You will build relationships with business associations, accelerators, agencies, and AI communities across the region.

Feed insights back to the team - You will track community activity and share what you are seeing with the global community and marketing team.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a community builder, creator, or ecosystem operator, with a track record of working independently.
  • Hands-on conference or tradeshow experience, such as planning logistics, staffing booths, or running activations.
  • Comfort leading workshops, trainings, meetups, or community gatherings, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and build new skills.
  • You drive outcomes through relationships rather than headcount, and you are comfortable reaching out to new people.
  • Organized and proactive in outreach, follow-up, and event logistics.
  • Tech-savvy and curious about AI. You enjoy showing others how to use new tools.
  • Based near a major East Coast hub such as New York, DC, Atlanta, or Miami.
  • Able to travel frequently (often 25-50%), including some evenings and weekends, and to transport event materials.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with partners to co-host events, workshops, or conference activations.
  • Experience as a trainer or teacher.
  • Experience working with creators, small businesses, or SaaS products.
  • Existing relationships with East Coast business associations, accelerators, agencies, or creator networks.

Who Will Thrive Here

  • Wants to own a whole region, not run someone else's playbook.
  • Is as comfortable leading a room of small business owners as breaking down a booth at the end of the day.
  • Gets energy from meeting new people and turning them into partners and ambassadors.
  • Thinks about building something that keeps growing without them in every room.
  • Likes a flexible schedule where event-heavy weeks trade off with prep and outreach weeks.

Logistics

  • Engagement: Long-term contract, part-time.
  • Hours: 15-25 hours per week, varying between event-heavy weeks and weeks focused on workshop prep and outreach.
  • Location: Remote, US East, based near a major East Coast hub such as New York, DC, Atlanta, or Miami.
  • Travel: Frequent travel across the US East Coast plus occasional national conferences, with expenses covered.
  • Be the face of HeyGen across the East Coast and shape how creators and businesses adopt AI video.
  • Real ownership and autonomy over a whole region.
  • Work with a fast-moving, creative community and marketing team that values ambition, clarity, and curiosity.

A note on the application questions: please answer concisely and in your own words. Applications with long AI-written answers lacking substance will not be reviewed.

Equal Opportunity

HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Senior Consultant, Program Operations to join our Building Consulting team. This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial, highly driven individual to take on a role that combines property-loss project support with the operational coordination of vendor program assignments.

The Senior Consultant will oversee key operational workflows, including project intake and setup, portal management, KPI tracking, data accuracy, assignment monitoring, and coordination with internal teams.

The ideal candidate will have experience in supporting staff for property restoration, insurance, or vendor program operations and be comfortable managing multiple priorities. This role works closely with clients, consultants, and internal teams to promote consistency, accuracy, responsiveness, and quality across the Building Consulting practice.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate new project and assignment intake across multiple systems, ensuring information is complete, accurate, and aligned with client and vendor requirements.
  • Receive project requests, complete new project forms, and coordinate submissions with the Project Coordination Team.
  • Set up and maintain projects in XactAnalysis, Cotality, and other vendor program systems.
  • Monitor project information throughout the assignment lifecycle and follow up on missing or incomplete information.
  • Track assignment status, billing information, payor details, deadlines, and overall project progress.
  • Monitor vendor portals and assignments to ensure alignment with applicable service agreements and client expectations.
  • Track KPIs and assist with collecting, organizing, validating, and updating performance-related information.
  • Prepare status updates and maintain accurate project and program reporting.
  • Complete day-to-day production tasks associated with vendor program assignments.
  • Coordinate with colleagues across multiple offices to support project execution and timely delivery.
  • Participate in daily and weekly meetings as required.
  • Maintain high standards of internal and external client service.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent with 10-12 years of relevant experience in operations, restoration, insurance, construction, or a related field; OR an associate degree from an accredited college or university with 8-10 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in the restoration, insurance, or property-loss industry
  • Experience executing or coordinating XactAnalysis or other vendor program assignments.
  • Proficiency with Xactimate and XactAnalysis.
  • Familiarity with Cotality, CoreLogic/Symbility, or similar estimating and vendor program platforms.
  • Experience supporting project setup and intake workflows, including documentation and coordination across teams.
  • Ability to track KPIs, maintain organized records, and support reporting requirements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Sound judgment, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong customer-service mindset with the ability to respond to internal and external requests professionally and promptly

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Experience with vendor programs such as Alacrity, Frontline, or CAN.
  • IICRC-related credentials or certifications.
  • Experience supporting complex commercial or residential property-loss projects.

Physical and Mental Job Qualifications:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  • Willingness to travel locally and regionally and participate in catastrophe response when needed.

J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

  • Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
  • Flexible Time Off policy
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401k Match
  • Commuter Benefit

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000. Any offered salary range is based on a wide array of factors including but not limited to skillset, experience, training, location, scope of role, management responsibility, etc.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein. California residents can click here to learn more about the personal information we collect and here to learn about additional privacy rights that may be available.

Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.

EEO and Job Accommodations

We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!

J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.title: Strategic Account Executive
raw.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
raw.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Join Syndio to sell mission‑driven, category‑defining tech. We help companies get pay right. For almost a decade, we have led in pay equity software and now, with Decisions, we are delivering instant, explainable guidance for offers, promotions, and adjustments right where work happens. Decisions embeds fairness with policy‑aligned recommendations and auditable guardrails, helping customers hire faster, reduce attrition, strengthen compliance (such as navigating the EU Pay Transparency Directive), mitigate enterprise risk, and improve performance.

You'll help the world's largest employers move from fixing pay once a year to getting it right every time by partnering with C-suite executives—including CHROs, CFOs, General Counsels, and Heads of Total Rewards—framing pay governance and AI decision intelligence around enterprise risk, regulatory compliance, and measurable financial ROI. Because we're creating a category, we need a strategic AE comfortable with ambiguity: testing new approaches, learning fast, and folding what works into your talk track. Expect high impact, true enterprise rigor, and a product you can be proud to sell.

Why this job is exciting

  • Own the full sales cycle, from self-sourcing high-value enterprise pipeline to close. You'll partner with our ADRs and Marketing, executing proactive territory strategies to build a self-directed pipeline.
  • Execute rigorous territory planning and target account strategies to drive self-sourced enterprise pipeline creation and consistently exceed your quota goals.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals ($200k target ACV, 6–12 month sales cycles), navigating buying committees of 10–15 people across HR, Legal, Finance, and Procurement.
  • Act as a true strategic quarterback: orchestrate core demos, coordinate internal subject matter experts (Solutions Engineers, labor economists, data scientists, legal experts, executive sponsors), and tailor distinct value narratives for each stakeholder.
  • Participate in the RFP process for prospects, including qualifying leads to ensure a good fit and providing a final review of all responses.
  • Operate with the mentality that sales is a team sport, and bring in Syndio SMEs (e.g. lawyer, labor economist, data scientist, testifying expert, CEO) to help you win and exceed your goals.
  • Get in front of customers: drive active field-based selling by regularly traveling for key customer onsites, flying out to meet senior stakeholders, and hosting in-person executive meetings and events.
  • Operate as a self-directed owner of your territory in a fully remote, distributed team. You'll build your own structure and cadence rather than wait to be told what to do next.

About you

  • You have more than 7+ years experience in sales, and 5 years as a closer
  • Proven track record of closing complex enterprise deals ($150k+ ACV) across 6–12 month cycles while multi-threading with C-suite executives (CHROs, CFOs, General Counsels).
  • You've sold somewhere scrappy. When something wasn't built yet, or a client asked a question you couldn't answer, you figured it out instead of waiting for a team to do it for you
  • You forecast accurately because you know your deals: you spot what's missing and work with your manager to close the gap
  • You can run a confident product demo and tell the story behind it, and you know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer
  • You are proficient in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach (or equivalent), and Gong. You use AI tools (e.g. Claude/ChatGPT, Gong AI, Clay) as a normal part of how you research accounts, prep for calls, and personalize outbound, not as a novelty, and you bring ideas for where technology can help the team
  • You have a highly disciplined approach to selling, with the ability to solve complex deal puzzles and strategically navigate non-traditional enterprise hurdles beyond relying solely on standard framework steps like MEDDPICC
  • You are savvy, capable of curating a thoughtful approach to pay equity, diversity and inclusion, and workplace fairness for each individual client
  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, building your own playbook when one doesn't fully exist yet, rather than waiting for one
  • You bring a positive attitude, hustle, and persistence to your role
  • You are an excellent communicator, able to build relationships quickly with your colleagues, clients, and prospects
  • You're consultative, not scripted. You're curious, a great listener who knows where to poke and prod with prospects to inspire them to take action and drive organizational change
  • You know how to drive a deal and proactively lead prospects and customers (rather than reacting to their requests)
  • You are proficient with spreadsheets, presentation, and project management business applications
  • You are committed to our mission of workplace equity and passionate about Syndio products

Extra credit

  • Experience selling to compensation and total rewards professionals
  • Overall understanding of the HR technology landscape
  • Background selling compensation, HR, Business Intelligence/Analytics solutions
  • Experience selling an AI-native or AI-augmented product, where the pitch itself has to explain how the AI works, not just what it does
  • A track record of in-person, field-based selling: onsites, coffees, and events that build relationships beyond Zoom

Role progression

We're rebuilding onboarding with AI built in across every function, so new AEs ramp faster, with a ramped quota through your first year.

  • Within 2 months, you'll know the core of Syndi, understand Essentials and Decisions, the pay equity and compensation space, and the vocabulary our buyers use. You'll be leading discovery calls and core demos, and you'll have a territory plan.
  • Within 3–6 months, you'll be building pipeline across your territory through outbound, events, and in-person meetings, and leading sales efforts at large enterprise accounts with SE support.
  • Within 6 months, you'll be confident in your role and will provide input into other areas of the business (e.g. marketing & product) based on what you're hearing from prospects. For reference, our most recent AE hire closed their first deal within 6 months and exceeded quota the first year.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our base salary is targeted at $155,000- $160,000 base per year with a $310,000 - $320,000 at target earnings, with no cap. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 🏦 401(k). To help you save for your future.
  • 📍Remote-first working model, with travel about 2-3 times per quarter

The Interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Strategic Account Executive position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  1. 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
  2. 45 minute zoom interview with the Hiring Manager
  3. Two 30 minute zoom interviews with the team - RevOps & an AE
  4. Zoom interview with a member of our executive team
  5. Mock Sales Presentation to panel - 60 minutes
  6. In person meet & greet

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.

raw.title: Account Executive
raw.excerpt: About FixiHouse FixiHouse builds lead products and software for the home improvement industry.
raw.description:
About FixiHouse

FixiHouse builds lead products and software for the home improvement industry. We generate qualified homeowner leads and deliver each one to a single contractor within a minute of it being created: one contractor, one quote. Every lead is TCPA-compliant and carries a TrustedForm certificate. We are AI-powered, and our workflows, lead qualification and operating discipline are designed around speed and quality. National home-improvement brands and regional remodelers already buy from us. The company is new; the people are not. Our team has spent their careers in home improvement and lead generation.

Job Summary

The Account Executive, Contractor Sales is responsible for winning new contractor partners for FixiHouse. The role takes first meetings booked by Business Development Representatives (BDRs), runs discovery and demo calls, and manages each deal through to a signed partnership, while also generating additional pipeline through its own outreach. Buyers are owners, marketing leaders and operations leaders at regional home-improvement firms, typically with $10–50M in annual revenue, many of them multi-location and private-equity backed. The Account Executive partners with BDRs, Partnership Management and the go-to-market (GTM) team to grow FixiHouse’s contractor network and revenue.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Conducts discovery and demo calls with owners, marketing leaders and operations leaders at home-improvement firms, using meetings booked by BDRs.
  • Leads discovery in unit-economics terms, including current lead sources, cost per lead (CPL), set rate, close rate, average contract value and target cost of marketing.
  • Presents how FixiHouse works and how much exclusive lead volume is available in the prospect’s service area, using the buyer’s own numbers to show the impact on net sales per lead.
  • Responds to objections with facts on exclusivity, speed to lead, TCPA compliance and lead allocation.
  • Generates additional pipeline through self-sourced outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn, and follows up on stalled deals.
  • Manages deals through each pipeline stage to a signed partnership, involving leadership on pricing and contract terms as needed.
  • Hands closed contractors to Partnership Management with complete notes so onboarding starts quickly, and works with Partnership Management to deliver each new partner’s first lead within 14 days of signing.
  • Records all activities, deals, ZIP code lists and lead caps in HubSpot before signing.
  • Provides feedback to BDRs on meeting quality and helps refine prospect targeting.
  • Shares market and customer feedback with the GTM and product teams.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None.

Success Measures

Goals are set quarterly. In a typical month, a fully ramped Account Executive is expected to:

  • Sign approximately 10 new valid contractors. A valid contractor operates where FixiHouse has lead volume, covers enough ZIP codes for its size, and buys at least 5 leads after signing.
  • Keep at least 85% of signed contractors valid (measured by partners who buy, not contracts signed).
  • Get new partners to their first lead within 14 days of signing, together with Partnership Management.
  • Build a balanced book: at least 1 in 10 signings is a large multi-metro installer and at least 4 in 10 are mid-size firms.
  • Enter every deal, ZIP code list and lead cap in HubSpot before signing.

Education and Experience Required

  • [Confirm education requirement, e.g., High school diploma or equivalent; bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience]
  • 3+ years of B2B closing experience as an Account Executive or in a similar role, with a record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience selling to home-improvement or home-services contractors, or selling lead generation, performance marketing or media to small-business and mid-market buyers.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.

Education and Experience Preferred

  • Experience at a lead marketplace, aggregator or pay-per-lead business.
  • Experience working in a BDR-to-Account Executive handoff model.
  • Knowledge of the bathroom, roofing, windows or home security trades.
  • Familiarity with bid-based or market-based lead pricing.
  • Working knowledge of TCPA and consent documentation such as TrustedForm.
  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-growing company.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Fluency in lead economics: CPL, cost per acquisition (CPA), set rate, close rate and cost of marketing as a percentage of revenue.
  • Strong discovery and demo skills; able to run a structured, consultative sales conversation rather than a scripted pitch.
  • Ability to communicate as a peer with business owners and private-equity-backed marketing leaders.
  • Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to manage a pipeline by the numbers, including conversion rates at each stage.
  • Daily use of AI tools to research accounts, prepare for calls, draft follow-ups, summarize notes and keep the CRM current.
  • Ability to take ownership of outcomes, work with limited supervision and handle ambiguity in a fast-growing company.
  • Honest, accurate communication with customers about current product capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive).
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication in English.
  • Commitment to compliance and to protecting confidential company, partner and consumer information.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Work is performed remotely from a home office within the United States.
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and frequently operate a computer, phone and video-conferencing tools.
  • Spends a large part of the workday on phone and video calls with prospects; must be able to communicate clearly by phone and video.
  • Must be able to read and interpret information on a computer screen.
  • Must maintain a quiet, secure workspace with reliable high-speed internet during working hours.
  • Must be available during US business hours; occasional early-morning or evening meetings may be needed to work with colleagues in other time zones.
  • [Confirm travel, e.g., “Occasional travel to industry events or contractor meetings” or remove]

This job description lists the essential functions and other duties considered necessary for this job. It is not a complete list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications, and duties may change at any time with or without notice. This job description is a guide only and does not create an employment contract. Employment with FixiHouse is at will.

Equal Employment Opportunity

FixiHouse is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. FixiHouse prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. FixiHouse provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for pregnancy-related limitations and sincerely held religious beliefs, unless doing so would cause undue hardship. To request an accommodation, contact Human Resources.

A large production fitness and lifestyle app (bookings, payments, social, video, embedded web apps) with a modular Swift codebase in active migration from UIKit to SwiftUI.

  • Apple frameworks: navigation patterns (NavigationStack / coordinators), background tasks (BGTaskScheduler), push notifications (APNs, UserNotifications), app lifecycle
  • Unit testing as a habit: XCTest and/or Swift Testing, mocking via protocols, testing async code and Combine publishers
  • Daily, effective use of AI coding agents (Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot) on a large codebase: giving them good context, reviewing their output critically, keeping quality and tests intact
  • Production ownership: Crashlytics triage, feature flags, App Store Connect, TestFlight, App Review guidelines
  • English B2+ (spoken: regular calls with UK stakeholders)

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality iOS features in Swift, from idea to production
  • Contribute to the migration from UIKit to SwiftUI in a modular codebase (Swift Package Manager modules / frameworks)
  • Integrate with backend REST APIs and third-party SDKs (authentication, payments, push notifications, media) and agree API contracts with backend and Android colleagues
  • Own app architecture topics: modularisation, state management, offline support, performance and testability
  • Use AI coding agents daily to speed up delivery, reviewing their output critically and keeping quality and tests intact
  • Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews, design discussions and technical decision-making
  • Own features in production: Crashlytics triage, feature flags, App Store Connect monitoring, TestFlight distribution and releases (including App Review)
  • Work with QA and DevOps on test automation and CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with the client's product owners and technical stakeholders, clarifying requirements and communicating risks and trade-offs
  • Mentor less experienced developers and help raise engineering standards

NICE TO HAVE

  • Third-party SDKs: Okta/OIDC (AppAuth), Adyen or other payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Firebase (Remote Config, App Check), OneSignal
  • WKWebView / hybrid apps (Capacitor/Ionic, Cordova), JavaScript bridges (WKScriptMessageHandler).
  • Media: AVFoundation / AVKit, AirPlay, Google Cast
  • Build tools and CI/CD: Xcode build settings and configurations, code signing and provisioning, Fastlane, build performance; CI/CD (Azure DevOps or similar)
  • UI / snapshot testing (XCUITest, swift-snapshot-testing, Maestro)

SOFT SKILLS

raw.description:
Full Cycle High Ticket Closer

Location: Remote — United States
Employment Type: Full-time | W-2 employee
Schedule: Approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET, with flexibility for prospect appointments as needed
OTE: (performance-based, uncapped commissions).
Target Earnings (Year 1): $100,000–$120,000. 150K+ at full Ad spend depending con the closer performance
Target Earnings (Year 2): $!50.000-$180.000+
Temporary Ramp Base: $4,000 USD per month during ramp-up, plus commissions
Commission: 12% on initial standard-package sales, 10% on initial higher-ticket sales, plus declining recurring residuals on personally closed clients
Commission Ceiling: Uncapped. Earnings depend on actual sales and client retention.
Primary Market: U.S. med spas, aesthetic practices, and plastic surgery businesses

About the Company

Our client is an established advertising and creative agency launching a new growth-focused marketing vertical. The new offering helps med spas and other aesthetics businesses attract new customers while building a differentiated brand and stronger long-term customer relationships.

The Opportunity

This is the first dedicated sales hire for a growing business, and it is not an order-taking role. You will own inbound opportunities from first contact and qualification through discovery, presentation, objection handling, follow-up, and close.

You will work directly with the founder, help shape the sales process from the ground up, and have the opportunity to grow into a Sales Manager or Head of Sales role as the business scales.

The initial offer is a $3,000 monthly marketing retainer. Higher-tier packages in the $6,000–$10,000 range are planned as the offer matures. Leads will initially come from Meta Ads. The founder will run the early sales calls to set lead-quality and conversion benchmarks, and then you take over.

What You’ll Do

Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Quickly contact and qualify inbound prospects generated through Meta Ads and associated lead forms.
  • Schedule and confirm sales appointments, run discovery calls, present the offer, handle objections, and close new recurring-revenue clients.
  • Build trust with med spa owners, practice leaders, and other sophisticated buyers through consultative, confident conversations.
  • Follow up persistently and professionally with qualified opportunities to reduce no-shows and lost deals.
  • Identify relevant additional services and personally close upsell opportunities when appropriate.

Pipeline Ownership & Sales Operations

  • Own the pipeline end to end, with accurate CRM records, deal stages, follow-up tasks, and forecasts.
  • Track lead response, booked appointments, show rates, close rates, average deal value, and new monthly recurring revenue.
  • Work closely with the founder to refine messaging, qualification criteria, sales presentations, and repeatable sales processes.
  • Share frontline feedback on prospect objections, lead quality, offer positioning, and campaign effectiveness.

Founder Collaboration & Growth

  • Report directly to the founder during the launch and initial growth phase.
  • Help build a scalable, high-conversion sales motion for a growing inbound pipeline.
  • Show the ownership, leadership potential, and process discipline needed to help build and eventually lead a larger sales team.

Inbound First

The initial focus is on inbound leads. Outbound prospecting is not a defined requirement at launch. Lead volume, appointment volume, and closing benchmarks are still being established and will be reviewed after launch. This is a high-accountability, entrepreneurial environment that values professional communication and measurable sales outcomes.

Earning Potential

Temporary Ramp Base

  • $4,000 USD per month, paid in addition to commissions until your monthly residual commissions reach $4,000. At that point the base is removed.
  • The base is a ramp-up mechanism, not a permanent salary. The transition is anticipated to take about 2–3 months, but this is an estimate, not a guarantee.

Initial Sale Commissions

  • Standard offer: 12% of the initial sale of the standard $3,000 monthly package.
  • Higher-ticket offers: 10% of the initial sale of higher-tier packages, such as $6,000–$10,000.

Recurring Residuals (on clients you personally close)

  • Year 1: 10% of monthly recurring payments
  • Year 2: 5% of monthly recurring payments
  • Year 3: 2.5% of monthly recurring payments
  • Year 4 onward: No residual commissions

Upsells

  • 10% one-time commission on additional services you personally sell. Upsells do not earn residual commissions.

Example: For each standard $3,000/month client you personally close, the initial sale commission is $360 (12%). In Year 1, residuals are 10% of that client’s monthly recurring payments, which is $300 for each $3,000 monthly payment while the client remains active and paying.

Commission is uncapped. Actual earnings depend on sales volume, package mix, and the number of active paying clients. Residuals apply only while a personally closed client remains active and paying. All terms, including exact payment mechanics, are subject to the final written compensation agreement.

How to Apply

Submit an updated resume that highlights deals you personally closed, average deal sizes, sales-cycle length, and relevant recurring-revenue experience. Where possible, include examples of selling to business owners or professional-service buyers and, if applicable, building a sales process from the ground up.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven success in consultative, full-cycle B2B sales, with personal ownership of discovery, presentations, objection handling, and closing.
  • A strong track record closing recurring services or comparable business solutions, and the ability to discuss your individual sales metrics and outcomes.
  • Exceptional spoken English, executive presence, professional presentation skills, and the ability to build rapport quickly with U.S. business owners.
  • Comfort operating as the first sales hire and building structure where processes and benchmarks are still evolving.
  • Strong CRM discipline, consistent follow-up, initiative, resilience, and comfort with performance-based compensation.
  • Availability to cover U.S. business hours and respond quickly to inbound opportunities.
  • Based in the United States or Canada (UK candidates may be considered).

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to med spas, aesthetic practices, plastic surgeons, healthcare practices, or adjacent service businesses.
  • Experience selling digital marketing, advertising, branding, or other recurring agency services.
  • Success in shorter-cycle, higher-volume B2B sales environments.
  • Experience creating or improving a sales process and scaling a pipeline from an early stage.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM. Direct GoHighLevel experience is not required.
  • Previous team leadership, or clear potential to grow into a Sales Manager or Head of Sales role.

Benefits

  • Fully remote role for candidates based in the United States or Canada (UK may be considered).
  • Uncapped commission on initial sales and upsells you personally close.
  • Recurring residual income for up to three years on clients you personally close, while those clients remain active and paying.
  • Temporary $4,000 USD/month ramp base to support you while you build your residual book.
  • Inbound-first pipeline, with leads generated through Meta Ads and no defined outbound requirement at launch.
  • Direct collaboration with the founder and real influence over messaging, offer positioning, and the sales process.
  • Career growth: The opportunity to become Sales Manager or Head of Sales as the team grows, based on consistent high performance. Advancement is not guaranteed, and any leadership compensation would be negotiated separately.
