About M0

M0 is the modular stablecoin infrastructure. It gives businesses everything they need to launch a stablecoin built around their product, with separate, configurable layers for application, distribution, and issuance. Choose your regulated issuer, with the option to switch them later. Design how your stablecoin behaves with templates and custom logic. Tap shared liquidity across the network from day one. Other stablecoin platforms bundle every layer into a single fixed stack. M0 keeps them independent, so your stablecoin stays yours.

Who we're looking for

M0 is looking for a Business Development Manager to grow our pipeline of crypto-native companies, fintechs, and exchanges that launch, distribute, and build on M0 stablecoins.

As Business Development Manager, you will report directly to our Chief Growth Officer and play a key role in sourcing, qualifying, and closing partnerships across wallets, structured products, DeFi protocols, and payments companies. The ideal candidate will have expertise in working within the stablecoin and digital-asset ecosystem and in moving technical deals from first conversation to signed agreement and live integration. You're plugged into crypto, commercially driven, eager to learn the technical and regulatory side, and excited to help build a pipeline at a fast-moving startup.

What you'll do

  • Build the pipeline. Research, prioritize, and reach out to target partners across exchanges, wallets, fintechs, and DeFi protocols. Keep pipeline data clean and current in our CRM.
  • Run and close deals. Own deals from discovery through commercial terms and signature, partnering with senior BD, Legal, and Finance on larger or more complex agreements.
  • Support stablecoin launches. Help partners design and launch their own stablecoin on M0, coordinating with issuers, engineering, and solutions teams to get them live.
  • Grow distribution and liquidity. Drive integrations and listings that expand where M0 stablecoins can be held, traded, and used across chains and venues.
  • Share what you hear. Bring partner and competitor insights back to Product and Leadership to inform roadmap, pricing, and positioning.
  • Represent M0 in the ecosystem. Attend conferences, industry events, and community spaces to grow M0's network and reputation.

Skills and attributes

  • Crypto fluency: you understand stablecoins, on-chain liquidity, and DeFi and keep up with the market.
  • Strong commercial instincts and a good feel for what makes a deal work for both sides.
  • Technical curiosity to follow conversations with engineers on smart contracts, chains, and integrations.
  • Self-directed and resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities at a startup.
  • Clear, persuasive communicator in writing and on calls.
  • Relationship-driven, earning trust with founders, operators, and technical leads alike.

Required qualifications

  • 3–5 years in business development, partnerships, or B2B sales; strong candidates with slightly less will be considered.
  • At least 1–2 years working in crypto, digital assets, or blockchain infrastructure. This is non-negotiable.
  • Working familiarity with stablecoins and the ecosystem around them: issuers, exchanges, wallets, and DeFi protocols.
  • A track record of closing B2B deals or partnerships, ideally ones that involved a technical integration.
  • A growing network across crypto-native companies and/or fintechs.
  • Based in the US and able to travel for conferences and partner meetings (roughly 20–30% of the time).

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at a stablecoin issuer, exchange, custodian, or infrastructure provider.
  • Awareness of stablecoin regulation (e.g., the GENIUS Act, MiCA) and how it shapes partner decisions.
  • Prior experience at a Seed to Series B startup.
  • An engineering, product, or solutions background, or hands-on experience with on-chain projects.

Compensation

  • Competitive compensation (base salary with equity/token grant) commensurate with experience.

Benefits

  • Global team and flexibility: Join a worldwide team spanning five continents, with the flexibility to work remotely or from one of our hubs in NYC or Berlin.
  • Health and wellness: Enjoy comprehensive healthcare insurance coverage as well as a wellbeing allowance and gym membership to support your physical and mental health.
  • Customizable IT setup: Tailor your workspace with access to top-notch IT equipment.
  • Professional development: Benefit from an annual development budget to enhance your skills and grow professionally, including opportunities to participate in conferences and on-site company events worldwide.

About Wahed:
The global financial system wasn't built for everyone. For millions of people, its reliance on interest (riba) creates a barrier to managing money and building wealth without compromising their values.

At Wahed, we're changing that. We are a global fintech company on a mission to build a new financial system—one that is ethical, accessible, and entirely interest-free. From our offices across the globe, our team is building products that were once deemed impossible, from pioneering Shariah-compliant equity ETFs, creating riba-free alternatives to high yield savings accounts, to creating no-leverage real estate investments for truly interest-free income producing assets. If you're driven to solve complex problems and believe finance should empower, not exclude, join us in building a more equitable financial future.

Job Brief:
As Wahed prepares to launch in Australia, we're looking for an experienced Responsible Manager (RM) to support our Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL) application and oversee the ongoing provision of financial services. This is a key role in establishing Wahed's presence in Australia, working closely with senior leadership, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure our services meet Australian regulatory requirements.

Job Description:

  • Take responsibility for significant day-to-day decisions relating to the provision of financial services under Wahed Australia's AFSL.
  • Provide oversight of financial services operations, regulatory compliance, risk management, and governance.
  • Support the AFSL application and oversee regulatory and operational readiness for the Australian launch.
  • Oversee activities relating to general financial product advice and dealing in financial products, within Wahed Australia's authorised scope.
  • Collaborate with legal, compliance, product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure financial services are delivered in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify and address material regulatory, compliance, and operational risks, escalating significant issues to senior leadership as appropriate.
  • Review significant operational decisions and ensure appropriate governance frameworks, policies, and internal controls are maintained.
  • Support ongoing regulatory compliance, including engagement with ASIC and relevant internal and external stakeholders.

Job Specification:

  • Relevant qualifications and industry experience satisfying at least one of ASIC's five competency pathways under Regulatory Guide 105 (RG 105).
  • Typically, at least 3 years of relevant experience within the past 5 years, or an alternative qualifying pathway under RG 105.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian financial services regulations and AFSL obligations.
  • Demonstrable experience in general financial product advice and/or dealing in financial products, particularly securities, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), or managed investment schemes.
  • Experience in investment management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Sufficient availability and capacity to undertake the responsibilities of an RM, including significant operational decisions.
  • Strong analytical judgment, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and make sound decisions in a regulated environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.

    • Highly Desirable

  • Previous experience as an ASIC-nominated Responsible Manager for an AFSL holder.
  • Experience with retail investment products, digital investment platforms, or fintech.
  • Experience supporting AFSL applications, regulatory audits, or ASIC engagements.

    • Working Arrangements

  • This position is open to part-time or flexible arrangements, provided the candidate can demonstrate sufficient availability and appropriate involvement in Wahed Australia's operations.
  • The successful candidate must meet ASIC's applicable competency and fit-and-proper requirements. Appointment will be subject to regulatory and suitability assessments.
  • If you're passionate about ethical investing and helping build a regulated fintech business in Australia we'd love to hear from you.

Poszukujemy WordPress Developera – osoby, która zajmie się tworzeniem szablonów i pluginów do stron zbudowanych w oparciu o CMS WordPress.

CZEGO OCZEKUJEMY?

  • Doświadczenia w tworzeniu szablonów i pluginów dla systemu WordPress – WP podbił świat, jego dobra znajomość gwarantuje, że kawałek tego świata będziesz mógł zgarnąć dla siebie
  • Dobrej znajomości języka HTML – nie musisz mieć czarnego pasa w HTMLu; wystarczy, że będziesz w stanie poprawnie przetłumaczyć PSDka na język zrozumiały dla przeglądarki
  • Znajomości CSS i umiejętności korzystania z LESS i SASS oraz frameworka Bootstrap – czysty CSS jest passé, ułatwiajmy sobie życie
  • Znajomości JavaScript oraz frameworka jQuery – na stronie musi się coś dziać, ruszać i zachwycać użytkownika; mówimy stanowcze nie smutnym i nieużytecznym stronom
  • Doświadczenia w programowaniu obiektowym w PHP – nie wymagamy nie wiadomo czego, podstawy i umiejętność zgrabnego posługiwania się OOP będzie git, a skoro o gicie mowa…
  • Umiejętności obsługi systemu kontroli wersji GIT i pracy w zespole – komunikacja to podstawa, więc bez tego ani rusz; nie jesteśmy tacy straszni ?
  • Podstawowej znajomości Photoshopa (cięcie grafiki) – nie musisz być artystą, ostry jak brzytwa kursor wystarczy
  • Zorientowania wśród panujących trendów dotyczących tworzenia stron – musisz wiedzieć, co jest ładne i modne, żeby dotrzymać tempa szybkiemu rozwojowi web
  • Umiejętności rozwiązywania problemów wynikłych w procesie tworzenia – life is brutal, czasem coś się posypie i musisz to naprawić

Dodatkowymi atutami będzie znajomość Bedrock’a i Sage’a oraz wtyczek do WordPress’a: WooCommerce, WPML, Visual Composer. Mile widziana będzie również umiejętność posługiwania się narzędziami takimi jak Gulp, Bower, Composer.

CO OFERUJEMY?

  • Bycie częścią młodego, start-up’owego zespołu nastawionego na zdobywanie i dzielenie się wiedzy
  • Możliwość rozwoju i zdobywania doświadczenia przy międzynarodowych projektach
  • Możliwość wyjazdu na szkolenia i konferencje branżowe
  • Wynagrodzenie adekwatne do umiejętności
  • Miłą atmosferę i elastyczne godziny pracy

raw.description:
About Profound Research

Profound Research partners with community physicians to offer clinical trials as a therapeutic option for their patients. We handle all infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and administrative operations so physicians can focus on patient care. Our model gives patients access to the newest therapies while maintaining the trusted patient-physician relationship.
Our Mission: Improving Lives by Providing Advanced Therapeutic Options
Our Vision: Creating the Absolute Best Patient-Physician Experience in Clinical Research

Our Values:

  • Compassion: We prioritize the patient-physician relationship, ensuring every interaction is service-oriented and patient-centered.
  • Urgency: We work hard and practice selflessness, acting swiftly and decisively to meet the needs of our patients, partners, and colleagues.
  • Solution Orientation: We embrace challenges with a positive mindset, communicate directly, and identify and implement effective solutions with efficiency.
  • Excellence: We insist on excellence, holding ourselves accountable and empowering each other to deliver best-in-class service while maintaining the highest ethical and scientific standards.

Why This Role Exists

    The Patient Engagement Specialist (Centralized) owns patient engagement and recruitment across assigned studies and sites, from first contact with a prospective participant through pre-screening, scheduling, and follow-up into clinical screening. Working from the centralized Patient Engagement team, this role supports multiple clinical trial sites at once.

    For many prospective participants, this role is their first conversation with Profound Research. The Specialist decides how to reach and engage each person, creates a responsive and patient-centered experience, and supports sites in meeting enrollment goals.

    What You’ll Own

    Patient Recruitment & Pre-Screening

  • Own recruitment for assigned studies and sites, including inbound and outbound outreach, pre-screening, scheduling, and follow-up through the handoff into clinical screening

  • Assess prospective participants against protocol eligibility criteria and determine whether to advance, hold, or close each candidate, escalating clinical questions to the appropriate resource

  • Determine the approach, timing, and messaging most likely to reach and engage each prospective participant, working within approved materials and communication methods

  • Build and apply working knowledge of assigned protocols, eligibility criteria, medical terminology, and study-specific recruitment considerations

  • Provide prospective participants with clear, accurate, and approved information about study participation and next steps

  • Deliver a compassionate and professional patient experience across every conversation

    • Recruitment Funnel & Priorities

  • Maintain an accurate view of assigned leads and prospective participants across each stage of the recruitment funnel

  • Decide how to sequence outreach and follow-up across studies and sites when demands compete, based on patient status, study urgency, and enrollment impact

  • Identify barriers affecting patient progression and adjust day-to-day approach when results indicate something is not working

  • Escalate recruitment barriers, capacity constraints, and competing priorities with enough context to support a timely decision

  • Communicate recruitment progress, patient trends, and operational concerns to site and Patient Engagement stakeholders

    • Site & Team Coordination

  • Partner with clinical research coordinators and site teams to support organized patient handoffs and coordinated recruitment execution

  • Maintain a working understanding of the sites supported, including scheduling realities and site-specific considerations that affect patient progression

  • Support recruitment across additional studies or sites as priorities shift, and communicate when competing demands may affect execution

  • Participate in recruitment reviews, team meetings, and process improvement discussions

  • Share effective practices with Patient Engagement colleagues and help new team members get oriented to studies, systems, and workflows

    • What You Bring

  • Experience in a role requiring frequent direct contact with patients, customers, or the public, including academic, volunteer, or part-time work

  • Clear verbal and written communication with a professional and compassionate phone presence

  • Comfort working in a high-volume outreach environment, both inbound and outbound

  • Ability to learn and apply study protocols, eligibility criteria, and medical terminology

  • Sound independent judgment in managing patient situations, competing priorities, and day-to-day recruitment decisions

  • Strong organization and attention to detail while managing several studies and sites at once

  • Comfort learning and working across multiple systems

  • Ability to work effectively and stay connected to colleagues and site teams in a remote environment

    • Preferred Qualifications 

  • Associate degree or higher

  • Experience in clinical research patient recruitment or engagement

  • Experience in healthcare outreach, patient access, scheduling, call center, sales, or other performance-driven environment

  • Experience conducting chart or schedule reviews in an electronic medical record system

  • Experience supporting multi-site clinical research operations

  • Experience using a clinical trial management system, patient tracking system, or third-party recruitment platform

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Role

description: We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark.

raw.title: Data Analyst - Platform Migration
raw.excerpt: We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark.
raw.description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.

You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. Your job is the data: understanding what each acquired platform holds, getting it into Veremark correctly, and showing it's right. You'll also make each integration quicker than the last, by building reusable mappings, queries and checks.

What you'll do

Profile and map

  • Profile each acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, client usage, active vs dormant accounts, data quality and the edge cases the documentation misses.

  • Build and maintain field-level mappings between the two data models, covering check types, client configurations, candidate records and history.

  • Raise gaps between what the source holds and what Veremark needs, with evidence, so the product team can decide.

Migrate and prove

  • Validate and reconcile each client cohort before and after migration: counts, key values, statuses and outcomes.

  • Log every difference and trace it to a cause: the source data, the mapping or the expectation.

  • Prepare the evidence pack that lets a cohort be signed off, and support UAT with the people who check it.

Integrations and commercial data

  • Keep an inventory of each client's ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and their migration status.

  • Map products, price books and contract terms, and help Finance reconcile billing between each acquired platform and Veremark.

Report

  • Own the migration dashboards for every integration in progress and contribute to the Programme Director's weekly update.

  • Give Customer Success and Sales the client data they need to plan each move.

  • Use AI to work faster: query data with prompts, draft and review SQL, generate first-pass mappings and documentation, and automate routine checks, always verifying results against the source.

Make each integration faster

  • Build a reusable library of profiling and reconciliation SQL, mapping templates and sign-off checklists.

  • Feed what you learn back into the integration playbook after each deal.

  • Where needed, review a target company's data before a deal closes, so we know what we're taking on.

Must have

    • 3+ years as a data analyst, with hands-on work on at least one data migration, platform consolidation or system implementation. Tell us what you moved, how much, and what went wrong.

    • Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions and aggregation, used to profile unfamiliar data and reconcile a source against a target.

    • Confident with AI and new tools: you already use AI in your daily work, for example querying data with prompts, drafting and reviewing SQL with an LLM, or using AI features in your BI tool. You know where it saves time, and you check what it produces against the data.

    • Data mapping and validation: you've written field-level mappings, tested migrated data against them and investigated the differences.

    • Reporting: dashboards in Looker, Metabase or similar that non-technical people use.

    • Enough BA craft to work with the product team: documenting current and future state, writing clear requirements, and supporting UAT.

    • Clear communication: you can explain a data problem to a client success manager and a finance lead.

    • Comfortable working to a playbook: you follow an agreed process and flag what doesn't fit, rather than reinventing it, and help improve it after each deal.

Nice to have

    • Python for data cleansing and profiling

    • Experience with billing, pricing or contract data, or with systems like NetSuite or a CRM

    • Background in HR tech, background screening, fintech or another regulated industry

    • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse or Bullhorn, and with APIs and webhooks

    • Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit evidence

    • Previous post-acquisition or post-merger integration work

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, team-driven culture focused on collaboration and excellence.
  • Structured onboarding, tools, and resources to help you succeed.
  • Opportunities for career growth within the Candidate Support function.
  • Remote work
  • A chance to directly impact the candidate journey in a meaningful way

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

title: Strategic Supply Partnerships Lead
description: REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

raw.title: Strategic Supply Partnerships Lead
raw.excerpt: REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.
raw.description:
REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

Rather than treating acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience as separate disciplines, we help businesses connect them into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.

We're now looking for a Strategic Supply Partnership Lead to grow our performance ads business globally.

Tasks

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own and develop REPLUG’s performance supply ecosystem.

This is not a traditional account management role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to managing an existing book of supply partners.

We want someone with a genuine hunter mentality.

You should have a proven track record of identifying, approaching, and onboarding new partners, opening doors through your own network, and creating new commercial opportunities from scratch.

Strong industry relationships matter in this role. We are looking for someone who already understands the key players across the mobile performance ecosystem, knows who is worth speaking to, and can use that network to accelerate REPLUG’s access to new supply.

Just as importantly, you should have strong market intelligence. You should know what is happening across the ecosystem, where new inventory is emerging, which partners are gaining traction, where quality is deteriorating, and where the next meaningful opportunities may come from.

You’ll be responsible for identifying the partners we should work with, building the commercial relationships behind them, negotiating the right conditions and ensuring that those partnerships translate into real growth opportunities for our clients and REPLUG.

You’ll operate at the intersection of partnerships, commercial strategy and performance operations.

Your ecosystem will span OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, publishers, affiliate partners and other alternative acquisition channels.

You’ll work closely with our performance, operations and sales teams to ensure we have the right supply available to support client growth.

You will report directly to the Performance Ads Lead, while working alongside the founders.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Build and Grow Our Supply Ecosystem

You’ll continuously develop the network of partners that powers REPLUG’s alternative acquisition offering.

You will:

  • Identify and evaluate new publishers, networks and inventory partners globally.
  • Develop relationships with OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, affiliates and other performance partners.
  • Own partner onboarding from initial evaluation through activation.
  • Identify gaps in our current supply and proactively develop new opportunities.
  • Build a diversified ecosystem that allows us to scale without becoming overly dependent on individual partners.

Our goal is to build the right ecosystem to scale brands globally.

Own Commercial Partnerships

You’ll manage our supply relationships as commercial partnerships, not simply operational integrations.

This includes:

  • Managing and developing existing partner relationships.
  • Negotiating payouts, pricing models and commercial terms.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve margins and scalability.
  • Exploring exclusive opportunities, preferred access or new inventory.
  • Holding partners accountable for agreed performance, quality and delivery.
  • Understanding when a partnership should be scaled, renegotiated or stopped.

You should be comfortable protecting REPLUG’s commercial interests while maintaining strong long-term relationships.

Connect Supply With Performance

Supply has value only when it delivers results.

You’ll work closely with our internal teams to:

  • Match client campaigns with the most relevant inventory and partners.
  • Support campaign launches and supply activation.
  • Identify new scaling opportunities based on campaign performance.
  • Analyse partner performance across quality, delivery, scalability and economics.
  • Identify supply-side issues that may be limiting campaign performance.
  • Help teams diversify acquisition when existing channels begin to saturate.

You’ll need to understand both sides of the equation: what advertisers need and what partners can realistically deliver.

Protect Quality

Scaling poor-quality inventory isn’t growth.

You’ll help ensure that REPLUG’s supply ecosystem maintains a high standard of performance and transparency.

You’ll monitor and challenge partners around:

  • Traffic quality.
  • Fraud and suspicious activity.
  • Attribution anomalies.
  • Delivery consistency.
  • KPI performance.
  • Scalability.
  • Communication and operational reliability.

When something doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate it rather than accept the explanation you’re given.

Help Build REPLUG’s Own Performance Infrastructure

The role also extends beyond third-party partnerships.

You’ll contribute to the development of REPLUG’s own performance ecosystem, including:

  • Managing and optimizing supply operations for our in-house rewarded app ecosystem.
  • Supporting the development of our internal affiliate and network marketplace infrastructure.
  • Identifying opportunities to build more direct supply relationships.
  • Helping define processes, systems and commercial frameworks that make the ecosystem scalable.

This gives you the opportunity to help build infrastructure rather than simply manage existing relationships.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships sit somewhere between relationships, numbers and execution.

You should have:

  • At least 3-5 years of experience within mobile advertising, AdTech, performance marketing, or affiliate marketing.
  • A solid understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem.
  • Experience working with publishers, networks, DSPs, OEMs, affiliates, SDK traffic or comparable acquisition partners.
  • Strong commercial instincts and confidence negotiating deals.
  • The ability to evaluate a partnership based on performance and business potential, not just relationship quality.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with performance data and KPIs.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships across the mobile advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience managing international publisher or supply partnerships.
  • Experience with rewarded acquisition or offerwall ecosystems.
  • Understanding of attribution, MMPs and mobile measurement.
  • Experience working with performance campaigns on CPI, CPA, ROAS or revenue-based models.
  • Previous experience within a mobile agency, ad network, DSP, affiliate network or app growth company.
  • Additional languages.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Thinks commercially.
  • Is comfortable negotiating.
  • Follows through.
  • Makes decisions based on evidence.
  • Can operate independently.
  • Understands when to push and when a partnership simply isn’t worth pursuing.
  • Wants to build systems and relationships rather than inherit a static portfolio.

Benefits

Joining REPLUG means you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead the supply partnership strategy for ambitious mobile brands.
  • Work alongside mobile growth specialists, driving growth across the whole mobile ecosystem
  • Help shape one of the industry's emerging Mobile Revenue Growth consultancies.
  • Own and influence how we scale our performance ads business
  • Become one of the public faces of REPLUG through conferences, webinars and industry content.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and a high level of ownership.
  • Continue developing through learning, experimentation and industry events.
  • Access monthly health and fitness benefits
  • Access yearly educational budget

raw.description:
Senior Creative Project Manager

Job Overview

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Full - Time
  • Salary Range: $115,000 – $135,000 USD

About Us

Incubeta is an AI powered, end to end marketing agency that helps ambitious brands harness marketing as a driver of sustainable growth and long term business success. We operate where marketing is often most disconnected, in the gaps between teams, partners, strategies and technologies, turning complexity into coordinated action and measurable results.

Our proprietary Seamless approach and technology connect media, creative, data and technology into one integrated system. By removing the barriers that typically separate planning, production, activation and measurement, we help brands unlock greater performance, efficiency and profitability from their marketing investment.

Established in 2001 and operating across 18 countries, we combine global reach with local expertise to help brands navigate an increasingly complex marketing landscape. Our teams bring together deep marketing expertise with AI powered tools and platforms designed to improve how marketing is planned, produced and optimized.

Recognized for work that outperforms, we are trusted by leading brands worldwide to deliver meaningful impact and lasting growth.

At the heart of Incubeta is our people. We operate with an entrepreneurial mindset where individuals are trusted to take ownership, bring forward ideas and challenge conventional thinking. Rather than relying on rigid structures, we value accountability, initiative and collaboration. We believe our strength comes from the diverse perspectives, skills and experiences of our team, and we encourage everyone to contribute their unique expertise to make our collective work stronger.

The Role

Incubeta is seeking an exceptional, Senior Creative Project Manager to lead complex, multi-track creative engagements across our growing US client portfolio.

This is not a generalist IT or administrative project management position. The role requires a seasoned creative production leader, blending the tactical discipline of a senior agency producer with the design fluency and strategic acumen of an operational director. Partnering with Client Services and Creative Directors, you will serve as both an authoritative client-facing delivery lead and an uncompromising operational champion for our creative talent.

You will be accountable for end-to-end delivery governance, rigorous brief intake, scope protection, and seamless delivery workflows, ensuring all creative outputs meet world-class design standards while safeguarding team capacity and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Project Leadership & Delivery Governance

  • End-to-End Creative Ownership: Oversee the scoping, planning, execution, and delivery of complex digital marketing, brand, performance creative, display, social, motion/video, and AI generated creative campaigns.
  • Design Literacy & Asset Quality Control: Review briefs, technical requirements, and production milestones through a dedicated design lens. Evaluate whether creative requests or updates are feasible within allotted hours and all specifications are documented before work is assigned to the resources.
  • Creative Workforce Orchestration: Partner daily with Creative Directors and delivery resources to align program deadlines with resource capacity across multiple time zones.
  • Milestone & Sprint Management: Establish and manage project timelines, sprint backlogs, resource allocations, and dependencies using enterprise project management systems (e.g., Monday.com).

Stakeholder Management & Scope Discipline

  • Executive Client Services Partnership: Act as the authoritative delivery counterpart to Client Directors, balancing commercial urgency with realistic operational capacity.
  • Feedback Consolidation & Scope Enforcement: Partner with Clients and Client Services to ensure that feedback is in scope, fully consolidated, actionable, and aligned with project guidelines before reaching production. Manage out-of-scope requests in close coordination with Client Services, authoring change orders and protecting agency standards diplomatically.
  • Client-Facing Composure: Interface directly with senior client stakeholders during kickoff, status, and delivery reviews with high emotional intelligence, transparency, and strategic composure.

Operational Integration & Process Adherence

  • Intake & Brief Gatekeeping: Enforce strict group intake protocols. Return vague briefs that lack core creative direction, mandatory assets, clear deliverables, or target KPIs.
  • Continuous Operational Refinement: Identify systemic production friction points, bottlenecks, and cross-team disconnects, proactively proposing and implementing process optimizations and tooling automations.

Financial & Commercial Accountability

  • Estimate & SOW Formulation: Partner with Client Services, Creative Directors, and PMO to forecast resourcing for the portfolio, building accurate, profitable resource estimates, statements of work (SOWs), and delivery burn forecasts.
  • Budget Tracking & Utilization: Actively monitor project burn rates, allocated vs. actual designer hours, and change requests, preventing margin erosion through real-time commercial governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Level: 6+ years of progressive project management / creative production experience within a digital marketing agency, creative agency, or high-velocity brand studio, including at least 3+ years in a senior or lead delivery role (Senior PM, Executive Producer, or Project Director).
  • Creative & Design Background (Mandatory): Demonstrated background in design, visual arts, creative technology, or rich media production. Must possess working fluency in digital design vocabulary, asset formats, Figma, and Google ecosystems, digital ad specs, and motion/video pipelines.
  • Technical & Digital Fluency: Comprehensive understanding of performance creative, paid media assets, digital display, and analytics-driven asset scaling.
  • Tooling Proficiency: Deep hands-on expertise with enterprise project tracking tools (Monday.com preferred, Asana, Jira), resource management platforms, and collaborative design review tools.
  • Cross-Border Delivery Experience: Proven track record collaborating across distributed, multi-timezone delivery teams.

Core Competencies

  • Authoritative Diplomacy: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills. Able to manage difficult conversations, push back constructively against client and internal pressures, and build trust across diverse teams.
  • Workload Prioritization: Ability to thrive under high-volume delivery cycles without losing composure or compromising quality standards.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Forward-looking mindset that anticipates production bottlenecks, resourcing deficits, and scope creep before they impact delivery timelines.
  • Operational Integrity: High attention to detail with an insistence on structured workflows, thorough documentation, and process consistency.

What to Do Next

If this sounds like the right next step for your career, we’d love to hear from you!

Ready to join the team? Click "Apply Now" to get started.

Most new hires fall within the posted salary range, with opportunities to earn more over time based on individual and company performance. Initial offers are determined by several factors including relevant knowledge, skills, experience and location.

As a general policy, Incubeta does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Salary: $115,000 – $135,000 / year

Who We Are

Indigenous Youth Roots is a national, Indigenous youth-led organization rooted in community. We envision a future where Indigenous youth are connected, empowered, and thriving as leaders within their communities. We work alongside communities to offer programs, grants, and opportunities grounded in Indigenous ways of knowing and being, with the goal of strengthening and uplifting Indigenous youth voices. Our work is guided by seven core principles: Reciprocity, Innovation, Accountability, Reclamation, Advocacy, Resurgence, and Solidarity; along with being centered in Indigenous youth perspectives, that shape how we act and relate to one another.

At IYR, we center our people and our communities in all that we do. As a living wage employer, we honour the importance of balance by supporting flexible ways of working, time for ceremony, and the responsibilities that shape our lives. We are committed to meeting accessibility needs and creating a supportive, responsive work environment. Guided by purpose, we focus on meaningful outcomes that reflect our values, rather than upholding the status quo.

Your Impact

Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Finance Coordinator will provide administrative support to our internal teams by providing swift and thorough completion of the organizations financial tracking, documentation, and reporting. This role in collaboration with the Finance Department team will ensure responsible and ethical compliance, governance, and documentation of all organizational expenditures, assets, and investments.

Summary of Duties & Responsibilities

Administration and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and up to date financial records in compliance with organizational policies, funding agreements, and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)
  • Organize, file, and process financial documents including invoices, receipts, and reimbursement claims, ensuring accessibility for auditing and reporting.
  • Ensure proper categorization of financial transactions for accurate billing and tracing internally for budgeting purposes.
  • Assist in preparing financial reports for internal and external stakeholders, including funding partners and board members.
  • Utilize accounting software or spreadsheets to support budget monitoring and expense tracking organization wide.

Staff Support and Inquiry Assistance:

  • Respond to internal staff inquiries relating to financial procedures, expense reimbursements, budget allocations, and other general questions.
  • Guide staff through completing appropriate financial documents while ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory protocols.
  • Provide training or resources to internal stakeholders on financial systems and tools that improve their understanding of financial health / stability organization wide.

Billing Reconciliation:

  • Communicate and partner with internal and external partners to ensure accurate and efficient processing of any reimbursements, payments, or purchase agreements.
  • Support the Finance Manager in reconciling billing records with department budgets and vendor agreements for accuracy.
  • Maintain organized records of costs by department, project, or other specific venture to better record and provide analysis on cost efficiency of organizational pursuits.

Community Engagement:

  • Uphold and promote the organization’s cultural values and guiding principles in all workplace practices.
  • Engage with the Indigenous community and support initiatives that strengthen relationships and collaboration.

Health, Safety, and Wellness:

  • Carry out your duties in a manner that does not adversely affect your own health and safety or that of others by reporting all potential hazards, all incidents, and injuries.
  • Co-operate, support, and engage with any measures introduced in the workplace to improve occupational health & safety.

Other:

  • Maintain high ethical standards and demonstrate integrity, honesty, and trustworthiness in all endeavours and communications.
  • Support and participate in all IYR staff, department, and team meetings.
  • Participate in external and internal committees, working groups, or projects as required.
  • Be available for in-person engagements when required and provided reasonable notice.
  • Undertake other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 2 years experience in a financial or administrative role
  • Certificate, Diploma, or Degree in a relevant field
  • Designation in finance, accounting, or payroll would be an asset
  • Strong administrative experience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with a high attention to detail.

Compensation

  • Salary: $55,614 - $65,060 annually
  • Health benefits: will begin following a 3-month probationary period
  • Other: GRRSP employer contribution that is 5% of salary (will begin following a 3-month probationary period)
  • Vacation: 15 days and statutory holidays, in addition to a 2-week winter closure
  • Personal Days: 15 days
  • Annual Professional Development Benefit: $1500 annually following a 3-month probationary period
  • Cultural Days: 5 days annually
  • Volunteer Hours: 5 hours monthly at any organization of your choice.
  • Flexible Work Week Options: 4 and 5 Day work week options.

Application Method

As a part of your expression of interest, please provide a cover letter that introduces yourself and share your passion for working alongside youth (especially youth in Indigenous, racialized, and newcomer communities) and highlight how your qualifications align with this role. IYR Prioritizes internal applications in an effort to support our commitments to development and growth, should we not have a qualified and interested internal applicant, external candidates will be considered based on competencies, skills, and relevant experiences (both lived and worked experience).

Accommodation & Equity

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you have any questions, please contact . IYR believes in barrier-free hiring practices. Please reach out to indicate how we can accommodate you.

Indigenous Youth Roots is committed to equitable representation and access. Candidates from Indigenous, racialized, 2SLGBTQ+, and other marginalized communities are encouraged to self-identify in the cover letter.

This posting is for an existing position with intent to hire for this position within the following 30 day period.

Salary: $55,614 - $65,060 annually

Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

As an Engineer on the Rail Water Resources team, you will provide various engineering and project management duties. You will assist with gathering survey data, hydrologic/hydraulic analysis and modelling, prepare technical reports, and review CAD drawings. You will assist with obtaining local, state, and federal permits for water resources related projects that impact regulated floodplains and various drainage districts. raw.title: Sales Representative
raw.excerpt: Fort Worth Heat and Air is hiring a phone-based Sales Representative to handle inbound and warm outbound calls from homeowners and small businesses.
raw.description:
Fort Worth Heat and Air is hiring a phone-based Sales Representative to handle inbound and warm outbound calls from homeowners and small businesses. This role is focused on converting interested leads into booked jobs and sold estimates, not cold-calling a random list.

You’ll spend most of your day on the phone: answering inquiries, following up on open quotes, explaining options, and asking for the business.

Responsibilities

- Handle inbound calls and web leads from prospective customers
- Make outbound follow-up calls on open estimates, missed calls, and past-due recommendations
- Ask structured discovery questions to understand the customer’s situation and needs
- Present clear options, pricing, and next steps (service visit, maintenance plan, replacement estimate, etc.)
- Confidently ask for the sale and secure verbal commitment
- Coordinate with dispatch/office to get jobs scheduled and information handed off cleanly
- Document all calls, outcomes, and next steps in the system
- Hit daily/weekly activity and sales targets

Qualifications

- Prior phone-based sales or customer service experience required
- Comfortable spending most of the day on the phone and asking for the close
- Clear, professional communication and strong listening skills
- Organized and consistent with follow-up and note-taking
- Willing to work an 8–5 schedule with some flexibility for peak call times
- Able to pass a standard background check

Compensation – Commission Structure

1. How Your Commission Works

You are commission-only. This plan is the entire structure.

A) New Residential System Installs

- Base commission: 10% of gross profit on each residential install.

- Gross profit = Selling price

– equipment cost (condenser, air handler/furnace, accessories)
– materials & parts
– install labor (fully loaded)
– permits & fees
– financing / dealer fees
– sales tax
- FieldPulse will calculate gross profit per job so your 10% is visible on each ticket.
- When you get paid: after the job is completed and all customer payments are received / financing funds and clears.
- If a job is refunded / written off, your commission on that job is reduced in the same proportion (up to full chargeback).

2. Install & Service Upsell Spiffs

You earn these whether the item is sold on an install or on a later visit, as long as it is on your ticket and paid.

Flat spiffs (paid after customer payment clears):

- 5-Year Labor Warranty: $135

- 10-Year Labor Warranty: $270

- IAQ Testing (basic): $25
- IAQ Testing – Registered Professional: $100
- Whole-Home Air Purification system: $350
- Honeywell Elite Pro 1200 thermostat: $50

Memberships (Comfort Club & Breakdown Shield)
- Comfort Club – Pay Now: $50 per prepaid year, capped at 3 years per system on a single sale.
- Breakdown Shield – Pay Now: $25 per prepaid year, capped at 3 years per system on a single sale.
- If a customer prepays more than 3 years, commission is still capped at 3 years for that sale.

- Comfort Club – Pay Later (billed every 4 weeks):
- You earn the same $50 per year, paid as a one-time lump sum after 12 consecutive months of on-time payments.
- If they cancel or go delinquent before 12 months, no Comfort Club spiff is paid.

  • Breakdown Shield – Pay Later (only with Comfort Club Pay Later):
    - You earn $25 one-time after 12 consecutive months of on-time payments.
    - If they cancel or go delinquent before 12 months, no Shield spiff is paid.

3. Discounts, Changes, and Rules

A) No unauthorized discounting

- You do not control pricing. Any discount must be manager-approved.
- If an approved discount reduces the price by X%, your commission and spiffs on that job are reduced by the same X%.

B) Paid on cash in, not promises

- You are paid only on collected cash / funded financing.
- If a customer signs and later cancels or never pays, that commission is not earned or is charged back.

C) One-page plan

- This document is the entire commission plan.
- Any changes must be made in writing, signed by both you and management.
- Verbal promises are not part of this plan.

D) Install vs. Non-Install

- 10% gross-profit commission applies to new residential system installs you sell.
- The upsell spiffs above apply on any qualifying ticket (install or service) where you are the salesperson of record.

If you’re coachable, hungry, and like turning conversations into closed deals, we’d like to talk to you.

Unser Kunde sucht Dich!
Die führende E-Learning-Plattform im DACH-Raum – ein SaaS-Unternehmen, mit dem Coaches, Unternehmen und Kursanbieter ihre Online-Kurse und Mitgliederbereiche einfach erstellen und verkaufen. Als Nummer 1 im E-Learning-SaaS-Bereich überzeugt die Plattform tausende Kund:innen mit einem starken Produkt, schnellem Support und einem klaren Fokus auf Wachstum.

Du übernimmst den Finance-Bereich eigenverantwortlich und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alles, was Budgets, Ausgaben und Liquidität betrifft. Du steuerst Kosten, behältst Zahlungseingänge und -ausgänge im Blick und sorgst mit präzisen Forecasts dafür, dass Entscheidungen auf einer soliden Zahlenbasis getroffen werden. Dabei berichtest Du direkt an die Geschäftsführung und arbeitest eng mit dem RevOps-Team zusammen – analytisch, pragmatisch und mit dem Blick fürs Ganze.

Aufgaben

  • Budget- & Ausgabensteuerung: Du steuerst alle Ausgaben und Budgets eigenverantwortlich, gleichst Umsatz- und Kostenlinien ab und stimmst Abweichungen direkt mit der Geschäftsführung ab.

  • Zahlungsströme & Forderungsmanagement: Du bündelst und überwachst alle Zahlungseingänge und -ausgänge, verantwortest das Forderungsmanagement und optimierst Bankkonten, Tagesgeld und Rücklagen.

  • Kosten- & BWA-Controlling: Du prüfst monatlich die BWA, identifizierst Einsparpotenziale und verfolgst Abweichungen konsequent nach.

  • Forecasting & Liquiditätsplanung: Du erstellst Umsatz-, Kosten- und Kapitalbedarfs-Forecasts und stehst im Austausch mit Banken und Kapitalgebern.

  • SaaS-Pricing & Profitabilität: Du analysierst Wettbewerb und Preiselastizität, entwickelst Pricing-Szenarien und leitest Maßnahmen ab.

  • KPI-Management & Reporting: Gemeinsam mit RevOps und den Fachbereichen definierst und reportest Du finanzrelevante KPIs wie Churn, Vertriebsprovisionen und Marketing-Tracking.

  • Buchhaltungs-Controlling: Du stimmst Dich eng mit der Buchhaltung ab und sicherst die Qualität von Buchungen sowie Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Controlling, FP&A oder Finance, idealerweise in einem SaaS-Unternehmen oder Startup

  • Sicherer Umgang mit BWA, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Liquiditätsplanung

  • Verständnis für SaaS-Kennzahlen wie ARR, MRR und Churn

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst operativ an und denkst gleichzeitig strategisch mit

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Austausch mit Geschäftsführung, Banken und Fachbereichen

  • Eigenverantwortung und die Fähigkeit, Dich im Remote-Setting selbst zu organisieren

Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Subscription-Modellen, Pricing-Analysen oder HubSpot.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote – arbeite von überall, ohne Pendeln

  • Volle Verantwortung für den Finance-Bereich eines wachsenden Marktführers

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst den Finance-Bereich, statt ihn nur zu verwalten

  • Ein starker Sparringspartner im RevOps-Team für Prozesse und BI

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit

🚀 Bereit für den nächsten Step?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt - Wir freuen uns auf dich! 💡

Die angegebene Gehaltsrange basiert auf aktuellen Marktdaten und gibt dir eine realistische Orientierung. Am Ende hängt es aber von zwei Dingen ab: deiner tatsächlichen Qualifikation – und vor allem von unserem Kunden, der die finale Entscheidung trifft. Wir sind eine Vermittlung, kein Arbeitgeber – das heißt, wir können das Angebot nicht selbst festlegen.
Was wir aber können: dich bestmöglich beraten, dein Profil stark positionieren und gemeinsam mit dir schauen, was drin ist.

Über NETSHAKE

Deutschlands E-Commerce-Incubator Nr. 1 und TÜV-zertifizierter Shopify Premier Partner – Top 1 % weltweit. 26 Jahre am Markt, über 1.600 Projekte, Standorte in Stuttgart und Dubai. Wir sind AI-First: Unsere Leads sind KI-vorqualifiziert, unser Vertrieb läuft über Close CRM mit Power Dialer. Du telefonierst nicht ins Blaue – du telefonierst mit System.

Worum es geht

Du hast schon am Telefon gearbeitet, im Kundenservice, im Callcenter oder in der Beratung. Jetzt willst du raus aus dem Großraumbüro, rein in einen Job, in dem deine Gespräche wirklich etwas bewegen.

Du bist die erste Stimme, die unsere Wunschkunden von NETSHAKE hören. Vier Stunden am Tag führst du Gespräche mit E-Commerce-Händlern und legst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Setter.

Der Unterschied zum Callcenter: Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführern, nicht mit Endkunden. Deine Leads sind KI-vorqualifiziert, und du wirst für gute Termine bezahlt. Nicht irgendwelche Termine. Termine, bei denen der Händler weiß, warum er im Gespräch sitzt, was NETSHAKE macht und warum es sich lohnt. Qualität bringt dich hier weiter.

Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest täglich 4 Stunden KI-vorqualifizierte Leads über unseren Power Dialer und stellst den ersten persönlichen Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden her.

  • Du führst jedes Gespräch entlang unseres Gesprächsleitfadens: souveräner Einstieg, Interesse wecken und qualifizieren, ob eine Zusammenarbeit infrage kommt.

  • Du gehst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Gesprächssituationen um und weißt, wie du auf Einwände wie „Keine Zeit“, „kein Bedarf“ oder „Schick mal was“ professionell reagierst.

  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Setter.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass jeder Termin, der von dir kommt, auch stattfindet

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mindestens erste Erfahrung am Telefon: Kundenservice, Callcenter, Telesales, Terminierung oder Kundenberatung

  • Du willst dich vom Kundenservice in Richtung Vertrieb entwickeln und bist bereit, dafür Gas zu geben

  • Du gehst ans Telefon, um zu gewinnen. Ein „Nein“ spornt dich an, statt dich zu bremsen

  • Du bist ergebnisgetrieben und zählst am Abend, was du erreicht hast

  • Du führst Gespräche selbstbewusst und direkt, übernimmst die Führung und bringst den Gesprächspartner zur Entscheidung

  • Du hast einen Qualitätsanspruch: Lieber drei Termine, die halten, als zehn, die platzen

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und diszipliniert und bist 4 Stunden täglich fest am Telefon

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau

  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, Headset

Benefits

  • Stundenhonorar + Performance-Boni: Du bekommst ein festes Stundenhonorar – und zusätzlich Boni für jeden Termin. Der Bonus richtet sich nach der Qualität des Termins, nicht nur nach der Anzahl. Wer gute Termine legt, verdient deutlich mehr.

  • Homeoffice statt Großraumbüro: Kein Pendeln. Du brauchst einen ruhigen Platz, stabiles Internet und ein Headset.

  • Keine Kaltakquise ins Leere sondern gezielt: KI-vorqualifizierte Leads, Power Dialer, fertige Gesprächsleitfäden. Du telefonierst, das System macht den Rest.

  • Training auf Vertriebsniveau: Du bekommst Skripte, Einwandbehandlung und Coaching. Damit machst du aus deiner Telefonerfahrung echte Vertriebskompetenz.

  • Vom Kundenservice in den Vertrieb: Opener, Setter, Closer. Wer liefert, bekommt mehr Stunden, mehr Verantwortung und mehr Einkommen.

  • Bei guter Zusammenarbeit sprechen wir gern über eine Festanstellung – in deutschen oder internationalen Strukturen, je nachdem, wo du lebst und wohin du willst.

  • Ein Produkt, das man gern verkauft: Shopify-Händler, die wachsen wollen – und eine Agentur, die das nachweislich liefert.

Passt das?

Wenn du am Telefon zu Hause bist und den Schritt vom Kundenservice in den Vertrieb machen willst: bewirb dich.

NETSHAKE. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Komm ins Gewinnerteam.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for driving business growth by developing strategic partnerships with key accounts, decision makers, and stakeholders. The role bridges customer needs with AbbVie’s portfolio, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical, and Market Access teams to execute account strategies, optimize pricing and supply management, support product access, and maximize revenue. The KAM leads commercial negotiations, monitors account performance, and implements growth initiatives to achieve business objectives while ensuring effective customer engagement and long-term account development.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Build an effective working influence network internally and externally to carry out account management optimization within the assigned commercial area. Contribute to driving prioritized strategies through the AbbVie Portfolio by integrating organizational and individual goals.

  • Align with company and brand goals to manage price negotiation, tender management, and margin, optimization to commit the price erosion within the defined KPI for AbbVie Product Portfolio.
  • Be responsible for new product listing on time and manage business performance of pricing impact at assigned accounts.
  • Build up long term partnership with KDMs (Key Decision Makers) / KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) with good network.

KDMs (Key Decision Makers) / KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders)

  • Develop and execute annual account plans and trade channel strategies to achieve sales and business objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Decision Makers (KDMs), Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and other key stakeholders within assigned accounts.
  • Identify customer needs and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver value-added solutions and drive account growth.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of customers’ business priorities, market dynamics, and competitive landscape to identify opportunities for partnership and growth.

Supply Chain & Pricing Matrix

  • Track purchase order issuance and ensure volumes support business objectives.
  • Develop pricing strategies and manage key account pricing activities.

Compliance (Legal Compliance)

Job Description


Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives everything we do. As we build our presence in obesity and related conditions, we have an opportunity to create connected, patient-centered experiences and meaningful engagement at scale.


What you will do

Activations are large-scale, culturally relevant brand experiences brought to life through media, live events, OOH, and partnerships. The Senior Manager, Activation & GEO will alongside the Associate Director, own activation delivery and cross-channel execution. The role also owns the media team’s GEO strategy, working with Corporate Affairs and external content partners to identify and develop opportunities that strengthen the brand’s visibility and content presence beyond owned digital properties.

What sets this role apart

• Pair activation execution leadership with a distinct media-side GEO strategy remit.

• Turn activation plans into coordinated cross-channel delivery with clear partner ownership.

• Connect external content opportunities with Corporate Affairs and the owned GEO work led by Digital Engagement.


Key responsibilities

Activation Execution and Cross-Channel Delivery

• Co-lead brand activation identification and development with the Associate Director, translating plans into coordinated workstreams, timelines, and partner deliverables.

• Own cross-channel execution coordination so activation content and experiences are delivered consistently across relevant touchpoints.

• Manage day-to-day activation logistics, dependencies, partner communication, and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with Consumer, HCP Promotion, Corporate Affairs, Patient Experience, agencies, and external partners as needed for delivery.

• Track decisions, milestones, risks, and open actions, escalating issues that affect timing, cost, or strategic intent.

Media GEO Strategy

• Own GEO strategy for the consumer team, identifying how external content and media-related opportunities can improve discoverability in generative search environments.

• Coordinate with Corporate Affairs and external content partners to identify, shape, and activate credible content opportunities.

• Partner with Digital Engagement, which owns GEO strategy for brand-owned properties, to align external opportunities with the owned web and technical approach.

• Work with Consumer and agency partners to ensure content opportunities are audience-relevant, strategically aligned, and routed through required review.

Partner and Process Leadership

• Build strong working relationships across media, activation, Corporate Affairs, external content partners, and internal stakeholders.

• Establish clear roles, handoffs, and working processes so activation and GEO work can move efficiently across teams.

• Support agency and partner management by clarifying briefs, deliverables, timelines, and feedback.

Delivery Learning and Governance

• Track execution quality and activation outcomes, sharing delivery insights with the Associate Director and Director.

• Develop practical measures for media-side GEO activity in partnership with Digital Engagement and analytics partners.

• Ensure activation and external content work follows brand, privacy, and review requirements.


What we expect of you

Basic qualifications

Doctorate degree and 2 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR Master’s degree and 4 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR Associate’s degree and 10 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR High school diploma/GED and 12 years of Marketing/Sales experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience leading integrated activations, cross-channel campaign execution, or content partnerships.

• Experience with GEO, search strategy, digital content discoverability, or emerging content environments preferred.

• Strong project management, partner coordination, and communication skills.

• Ability to work across media, Corporate Affairs, agencies, and matrixed teams.

• Pharmaceutical, healthcare, consumer health, or other regulated-industry experience preferred.


What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans

raw.description:
Your next conversation could start a great partnership.

You spot an interesting business and immediately start thinking: Who makes the decisions? What would get their attention? How could we help them grow?

Then we send an email, pick up the phone, reach out on LinkedIn – or combine these channels to connect with the right decision makers.

At qiibee, we connect businesses with loyalty programs such as Miles & More, Etihad Guest and many others. We help them use miles and points to attract customers, encourage repeat purchases and create more reasons to choose their brand.

We’re looking for an SDR who can take that story into the market, spark interest and turn it into qualified sales opportunities.

You’ll report directly to Elmo Hagendorf, our Head of Partnerships, and work with an international team that loves loyalty, thinks creatively and follows through. We bring energy, opinions and a healthy obsession with making things work. Bring yours.

🚀 Your mission

Find the right businesses. Reach the right people. Give them a compelling reason to talk.
Your focus is small and medium-sized businesses in the DACH region. You’ll research prospects, build relevant outreach and qualify opportunities before handing them to our Account Managers.

Success means creating outreach that sparks replies, questions, or meeting bookings—with a real chance of turning into business.


👉 What you’ll do

  • Find the fit. Identify businesses and decision-makers with a credible use case for qiibee.

  • Make your outreach relevant. Connect what you learn about a prospect with a clear commercial reason to speak.

  • Start conversations. Use calls, email and LinkedIn confidently, adapting your approach to the person and the opportunity.

  • Qualify with curiosity. Understand the business need, potential fit, decision-making context and willingness to explore a partnership.

  • Book meetings that matter. Set clear expectations, secure commitment and give the Account Manager the context to take the conversation forward.

  • Follow through. Handle early objections, re-engage promising prospects and keep your outreach organised.

  • Use AI intelligently. Work with our existing tools to research accounts, improve personalisation and refine sequences. Check the output and make it your own.

  • Keep HubSpot useful. Record accurate information, meaningful notes and clear next steps.

  • Learn from the funnel. Work with the AMs and Elmo to understand which meetings progress and use that feedback to improve your targeting and messaging.



🎯 What you bring

  • At least two years of SDR or BDR experience in Loyalty, CRM, Marketing, B2B SaaS or a comparable consultative sales environment.

  • A track record of generating qualified opportunities through outbound activity.

  • Fluent German and English, with strong writing skills and confidence on the phone.

  • The ability to research a business and turn what you find into a relevant opening.

  • Experience using a CRM and practical confidence working with AI tools.

  • Comfort with targets, feedback and the pace of a growing startup.

Loyalty experience is a plus. Curiosity about why people buy, return and stay loyal is essential.

You enjoy earning someone’s attention. You listen carefully, recover quickly from rejection and keep improving your approach. You own your numbers and care about what happens after the meeting you booked.

✨ Why qiibee?

  • A story people can connect with. Introduce businesses to loyalty currencies their customers already know and value.

  • Close collaboration with the people closing your opportunities. See what happens after handover and learn what makes a deal work.

  • Tools that help you move faster. Put AI to work while building the human skills that make sales effective.

  • Space to contribute. Test a new angle, challenge a sequence or bring us a promising customer segment. Good ideas get a hearing.

  • An international team with energy and personality. We work hard for our customers, support each other and enjoy the journey.

  • Remote. Work from wherever you do your best work, with reliable availability during our shared CET business hours.

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based variable compensation.

    🙌🏻 Ready to open doors?

    Apply through this application with your CV or profile and a short note: Choose one business you think would be a strong fit for qiibee and tell us how you’d start the conversation.

    Keep it brief. Make us curious.

    You open the door. We build the opportunity together. Let’s go the extra mile.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience providing counselling support to adults.
  • Valid professional indemnity insurance.
  • Good understanding of safeguarding and confidentiality requirements.
  • Excellent communication and clinical record-keeping skills.
  • Access to a suitable private environment for delivering remote counselling sessions.

Desirable Experience

What's on Offer?

  • Fully remote working.
  • Self-employed contractual arrangement.
  • Administrative and appointment scheduling support.
  • Access to a secure clinical management and video consultation platform.
  • The opportunity to focus on delivering client care with reduced administrative responsibilities.
