raw.description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

The GRC Engineer will play a key role in running and scaling Fever's security compliance programme. You will turn compliance from manual, point-in-time exercises into automated, continuously monitored controls, while running several audits in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS and others) and keeping them on time.

This role is "engineer-first" and also delivery-focused. You will work with engineering, security, privacy, finance and business teams to translate requirements into technical controls, build automated evidence collection, assess our vendors, answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs, and manage the compliance projects from start to finish across the Fever group companies.

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. This is an opportunity to have a real impact as a high-growth global category leader.

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, audit calendar and compliance roadmap.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will support SOC 2 initiatives: scope, control set, gap remediation and readiness for the observation period.
  • You will build automated evidence collection workflows using our compliance platform, AI and scripting.
  • You will run audit requests and auditor follow-ups for the ongoing certifications.
  • You will run vendor security assessments and answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will lead the SOC 2 audit with the external auditor, coordinating control owners across the company.
  • You will manage several compliance projects in parallel, with clear milestones, owners and reporting to leadership.
  • You will create a knowledge base and answer library that speeds up questionnaires, RFPs and partner reviews.
  • You will embed compliance checks and telemetry into a standardised GRC platform for continuous control monitoring.

Key responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Type II readiness, observation period and audit, and keep the controls operating effectively afterwards.
  • Participate in multiple audits and certifications in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS), coordinating evidence, auditors and control owners.
  • Translate requirements into technical controls and build automated evidence collection and continuous control monitoring.
  • Run the third-party risk management process: vendor security assessments, due diligence, risk ratings and follow-up.
  • Manage responses to customer and partner security questionnaires, RFPs and security assessments.
  • Plan and execute compliance projects end to end, reporting status and risks to leadership.
  • Automate compliance checks on AI governance and enablement.
  • Improve key information security processes, including risk management, policies and security awareness.

About you

Must have:

  • Hands-on experience preparing for and running SOC 2 Type II audits, from scoping to final report.
  • Experience managing international audits and certifications (ISO 27001, PCI DSS or similar).
  • Proven experience in vendor security assessments and answering security questionnaires and RFPs.
  • Programming/scripting/AI skills (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) and experience building API integrations to automate evidence gathering.
  • Strong project management skills: planning, prioritisation and stakeholder follow-up across teams.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in GRC Engineering, Security Compliance or Security Engineering in a cloud-native company.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, AWS security or equivalent.
  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g. Vanta, Drata) and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive compliance tasks.
  • Experience with AI risk governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
  • English and Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent-developer experience as the SDK evolves
  • Build automated tests for long-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
  • Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
  • Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations
  • Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
  • Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies
  • Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
  • Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable
  • Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
  • Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
  • Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests
  • Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off
  • Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
  • Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
  • Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
  • Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
  • Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
  • Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
  • Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
  • A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
  • Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
  • QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines
  • AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning

Desirable:

  • Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
  • Prior testing of multi-tenant SaaS isolation
  • Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
  • Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
  • Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
  • Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
  • Performance Testing: Experience testing high-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
  • Experience with qTest for test management

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

raw.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s this role about?

Auvik is looking for a practical, hands-on commercial lawyer to support Sales, Customer Success, and Channel. You’ll help move B2B SaaS customer and partner deals forward by negotiating agreements, applying established playbooks, and giving clear, timely legal advice.

You’ll be an independent-minded advisor who explains risks and options clearly, helping business partners make informed commercial decisions. You’ll analyze contract terms against company policy and industry practice and provide practical recommendations. The role focuses primarily on commercial contracting and go-to-market support, with senior legal leadership and outside counsel available for specialized or higher-risk matters.

What will I be doing?

  • Support Sales and Customer Success through customer contracting for U.S. and international prospects, including reviewing exceptions to online terms and drafting, negotiating, and finalizing addenda. Deal activity increases near the end of each month, quarter and year.
  • Handle requests from prospective customers, from routine contract questions to non-standard terms and negotiations. Work with internal teams and, as appropriate, customers, partners and vendors to resolve contract issues.
  • Review and negotiate reseller, channel, and other partner agreements; develop or improve standalone agreements as needed.
  • Advise on renewals, contract interpretation, and customer disputes. Summarize non-standard positions and explain their business implications.
  • Support Marketing on non-standard promotions and contest terms, and review vendor agreements as needed.
  • Coordinate trademark registrations and alleged infringement matters with outside counsel.
  • Provide practical contract and negotiation training, and improve templates, playbooks, intake, and escalation processes so the contracting process can scale with the business.
  • You’ll use Google Workspace, Jira for legal intake and workflow, and Slack and Zoom to collaborate across teams and time zones.

What are we looking for?

  • A U.S. law degree and an active license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, in good standing.
  • Approximately 4–7 years of relevant commercial legal experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for B2B SaaS or technology agreements. Candidates with fewer years may be considered if they demonstrate strong, independent negotiation judgment.
  • Experience negotiating customer and partner contracts and advising Sales, Customer Success, or other commercial teams.
  • The ability to manage deal volume, provide timely practical advice, and communicate clearly with non-lawyers.
  • Sound legal and commercial judgment: you can apply established playbooks, explain risks and options, and identify when a matter needs escalation.
  • An organized, collaborative approach and comfort working remotely across teams and time zones.

What success looks like?

  • Sales and Customer Success receive responsive, useful legal support for customer and partner deals.
  • Routine and moderately complex agreements move efficiently within established playbooks and approval limits.
  • Business partners receive clear advice and practical options, and understand that commercial decisions remain with the business.
  • Material or unfamiliar legal risks are escalated with a clear recommendation.
  • Contract guidance is clear and consistent.

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Mkt Manager Revenue Cycle Inpatient Coding, you will provide strategic oversight to our inpatient coding teams, holding them fully accountable for enterprise-established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including Discharged Not Final Billed (DNFC). You will serve as a subject matter expert in ICD classification systems and reimbursement methodologies, ensuring that all coding practices align with enterprise compliance plans. By acting as a critical liaison between CDI, clinical quality, physicians, and patient financial services, you will foster collaborative relationships that ensure the absolute accuracy and integrity of the inpatient medical record across our health system.

Every day you will actively monitor DNFC and coding work queues to ensure that all operational metrics are met, while managing team workflows to hit established productivity and quality standards. You will analyze performance data to identify gaps, developing and implementing targeted action plans for sustained improvement. Furthermore, you will facilitate communication across multiple departments to resolve complex workflow bottlenecks, ensuring that the revenue cycle remains seamless and compliant with the ethical coding standards established by AHIMA and AAPC.

To be successful in this role, you will possess the ability to resolve complex technical and operational issues, including remote troubleshooting for coding software and hardware. You must demonstrate strong leadership and organizational skills, with the professional ability to deliver high-level presentations to large groups and hospital leadership. Your expertise will be essential in assisting CommonSpirit Health (CSH) executive leadership with strategic planning and the development of high-impact presentations for combined coding and CDI steering committees.

  • Manage inpatient coding teams to achieve optimal performance, productivity, and coding accuracy benchmarks.
  • Direct oversight of DNFC workflows to ensure timely billing and efficient revenue cycle operations.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for ICD coding systems, reimbursement integrity, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CDI, clinical staff, and patient financial services to optimize documentation and coding workflows.
  • Develop and execute performance improvement plans to address coding quality and productivity deficiencies.
  • Drive strategic initiatives by preparing and presenting data-driven reports for system-wide steering committees and executive leadership.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Associates Other Associate’s degree in HIM or related field and 4-6 years
  • 4-6 years 5 years of recent management of hospital-based coding teams (hospital, large multi-facility organization, etc.)
  • 4-6 years Experience in process improvement strategies and mentoring staff
  • 4-6 years Previous experience effectively managing remote teams

Preferred

  • Bachelors Other Bachelor’s degree in HIM or related field
  • 3+ years of inpatient coding experience
  • 4-6 years Experience working in a level I/II trauma center and/or teaching hospital with complex conditions and procedures (cardiovascular/interventional radiology, orthopedic, neurosurgery, and obstetrics/NICU)
  • Experience working with a CDI program
  • Registered Health Information Administrator
  • Registered Health Information Technician
  • Certified Coding Specialist

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

raw.title: (Senior) Software Engineer – AI (m/f/d) – Remote
raw.excerpt: What we do MAIA is an AI platform for companies.  With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes.
raw.description:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As a Software Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Apply with your CV here and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

raw.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are looking for an AI Engineer Master to lead the architecture and delivery of production-grade AI solutions for complex challenges in the oil and gas industry.

You will work across the full lifecycle—from discovery and architecture to implementation, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement. You will turn generative AI and intelligent agents into secure, scalable, observable products that support engineering, project execution, asset operations, and decision-making.

As a senior technical reference, you will shape architectural decisions, define engineering standards, mentor engineers, and collaborate with product, domain, data, and software teams.

Responsibilities
- Lead the architecture of AI-enabled software products, balancing business value, scalability, reliability, security, governance, and cost.
- Define solution boundaries, integration patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for complex enterprise systems.
- Lead products from discovery and proof of value through production adoption and scale.
- Design and implement agentic and multi-agent solutions with planning, tool use, orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.
- Integrate AI with engineering applications, operational systems, APIs, data platforms, and other business-critical services.
- Build pragmatic knowledge-grounding solutions using search, embeddings, vector stores, and structured enterprise data when appropriate.
- Establish evaluation, observability, and monitoring practices for quality, safety, reliability, latency, usage, and cost.
- Drive cloud-native delivery, CI/CD, secure development, and infrastructure as code across development, staging, and production.
- Provide technical leadership in multidisciplinary initiatives and mentor engineers through architecture reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
- Translate oil and gas workflows into practical AI opportunities and implementation strategies.

Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
- Significant experience delivering software, AI, or machine learning solutions in production environments.
- Strong experience designing software architectures for complex, business-critical systems and leading technical decisions across teams.
- Proven ability to lead initiatives from problem framing through production adoption and continuous improvement.
- Advanced proficiency in C++, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
- Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLM applications, prompt engineering, tool use, and model integration.
- Experience with agentic frameworks or equivalent approaches for workflow-oriented AI systems.
- Experience designing APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, and cloud-native applications.
- Experience with cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, and IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent.
- Experience with AI platforms and tools such as Claude, Codex, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, or equivalent technologies.

Nice to have
- Hands-on experience with AWS, including services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, Step Functions, or EventBridge.
- Experience delivering agentic or multi-agent architectures in production.
- Familiarity with industrial and operational data, including time series, equipment data, technical documentation, and telemetry.
- Knowledge of engineering, subsea or offshore operations, maintenance, asset integrity, supply chain, or production optimization workflows.

If you enjoy combining deep engineering expertise, applied AI, and technical leadership to solve meaningful industrial problems, we would like to hear from you.

Role: Imagery Analyst (Drone & Maritime)

Role type: Contractor, part-time or full-time

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Opportunity Snapshot

Compensation: $35 - $85 hourly

Volume: Steady throughput expected; you set your own pace

Commitment: Part-time or full-time, your schedule

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Eligibility: This role supports a U.S. Navy project. Under the terms of that federal contract, it requires U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Common Access Card (CAC). Applicants who don’t meet these contract requirements aren’t eligible for this project — but we run other annotation projects without them, so we’d still like to hear from you.

Your tasks: Review and correct object labels on drone and maritime imagery

We're hiring imagery analysts for a U.S. Navy project that works with drone and maritime sensor imagery. The work is reviewing object labels that software generated on still images, fixing the wrong ones, and adding the objects it missed.

This project requires U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Common Access Card (CAC), both under the terms of the federal contract. If you don't meet these, you're not eligible for this project, but we run other annotation projects without these requirements and would still like to hear from you.

What you'll do

  1. Review bounding boxes and labels on still drone and maritime imagery, and correct the ones that are wrong
  2. Find and label objects the software missed
  3. Apply the project's labeling guidelines the same way on every image
  4. Work inside a secure Navy environment using the tools provided
  5. Flag unclear cases to the team instead of guessing

What we're looking for

  1. Active DoD CAC and U.S. citizenship (required)
  2. Experience identifying objects in aerial, drone, satellite, maritime or thermal imagery, for example ships, boats, buoys or aircraft seen from above
  3. Ability to tell similar objects apart and to explain why you made the call
  4. Accuracy over long sessions of similar work
  5. Experience reviewing or correcting labels, or doing bounding box annotation, is a plus
  6. Comfortable learning new labeling software
  7. Clear communication with the team when something is ambiguous

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and answer the screening questions.
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role. It's a spoken conversation about your experience with maritime and aerial imagery, and it's the most important step for moving forward, so please complete it as soon as you can after applying.
  3. Profile review.
  4. Onboarding with our Talent Ops team, who will get you set up.

Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Semiconductor & Vacuum Hardware

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in semiconductor and vacuum hardware. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in semiconductor or vacuum hardware.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

Role Title: Autodesk Fusion CAM Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully Remote-Open Worldwide

micro1 is engaging Autodesk Fusion Experts to contribute their advanced technical expertise to a customer’s AI training project focused on manufacturing and digital fabrication.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

This unique project centers on evaluating manufacturing processes and workflows, particularly with respect to CAM, CNC, and Fusion 360 environments. Your insights will directly support the development of evaluation rubrics designed to enhance human productivity, not replace it.

Teaching experience is highly preferred

Scope of Work

  1. Provide expert feedback on manufacturing processes and techniques, emphasizing CAM, CNC, or Fusion 360 applications.
  2. Review, assess, and refine AI-generated content and recommendations relevant to manufacturing workflows.
  3. Develop and validate detailed rubrics for evaluating manufacturing process accuracy and efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Proven expertise in CAM, CNC machining, and digital manufacturing workflows.
  2. Advanced proficiency with Autodesk Fusion 360 and related manufacturing software platforms.
  3. Strong written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on clarity and detail.
  4. Experience in developing or utilizing process evaluation rubrics is highly valued.

Process:

  1. Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions
  2. Complete AI interview (aprox. 30 minutes)
  3. Hiring Manager review

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

As a Coder, you will ensure precise communication with insurance companies so that services are documented correctly and payments are processed efficiently. Every day you will accurately translate patients’ medical records into standardized codes for diagnoses and treatments. Using your expertise and training, you will ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and organizational standards. To be successful in this role, you must combine accuracy and attention to detail with a strong knowledge of coding standards and healthcare regulations. Clear communication with providers and staff, along with efficient management of records, ensures claims are processed correctly and on time.
  • Accurately abstracts information from the service documentation, assigns and sequences appropriate CPT, ICD-9/10, and HCPCS codes into the appropriate billing systems, ensuring compliance with established guidelines.
  • Communicates professionally with providers, practice management, and other stakeholders either verbally or in writing.
  • Responsible for working encounters in the coding work queue or task lists in a timely manner.
  • Meets or exceeds organizational coding production and quality standards.
  • Understands and applies regulatory changes and stays current with coding updates, for example NCCI and MUE edits.
  • Reviews and resolves coding denials.

Job Requirements

Required
  • High School Graduate General Studies, upon hire or
  • High School GED General Studies, upon hire and
  • Certified Professional Coder, upon hire or
  • Certified Professional Coder Hospital Apprentice, upon hire or
  • Certified Professional Coder Apprentice, upon hire or
  • Certified Coding Associate, upon hire or
  • Cardiology Coding, upon hire or
  • Certified Coding Specialist, upon hire or
  • Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based, upon hire or
  • Certified Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery Coder, upon hire or
  • Certified Health Care Compliance, upon hire or
  • Certified Interventional Radiology Cardio Coder, upon hire or
  • Certified Professional Coder Hospital, upon hire or
  • Radiology Certified Coder, upon hire or
  • Registered Health Information Administrator, upon hire or
  • Registered Health Information Technician, upon hire
Preferred
  • One year physician coding experience and
  • Previous Electronic Health Record experience

Where You’ll Work

Welcome to CHI Saint Joseph Medical Group, a full service network of primary care services specializing in family, internal, geriatric and pediatric care serving 88 locations across central and Eastern Kentucky. CHI Saint Joseph Medical Group is dedicated to delivering customized care based on the unique needs of our patients and is recognized as a Best Place to Work in Kentucky for two years in a row (2023-2024).

CHI Saint Joseph Health is part of CommonSpirit Health, a non-proﬁt, Catholic health system dedicated to advancing health for all people. With approximately 175,000 team members and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice clinicians.

Our commitment to serve the common good is delivered through the dedicated work of thousands of physicians, advanced practice clinicians, nurses, and staff; through clinical excellence delivered across a system of 140 hospitals and more than 2,200 care centers serving 24 states.

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

Are you a passionate, solutions-oriented attorney looking for a new role in a fast-paced financial tech company? Joining YipitData’s legal team is a rare opportunity to become a core contributor to the success of a company that is building the future of investment research.

At YipitData, our Legal team is an essential and collaborative partner in the Company’s growth. As Product Counsel, you will be a core player in the Compliance pillar of the Legal team partnering with our Product team to advise on product and data legal matters from early-stage ideation through launch.

As Our Product Counsel, You Will:

  • Partner with our Corporate Product and Engineering teams from early-stage ideation through late-stage launch, advising on legal and compliance considerations throughout the product development lifecycle, while also supporting other product teams and cross-functional initiatives as business needs evolve.
  • Conduct compliance reviews of new and existing product features, ensuring they meet applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements before and after launch.
  • Advise on the data lifecycle and data pipeline, from sourcing to ingestion through processing, storage, and use, working closely with technical teams to identify and resolve legal risk early.
  • Review third-party data licenses and support due diligence on data partners, translating license terms into clear usage restrictions for product teams.
  • Document legal positions and rationale on key product and data issues, building an internal record that supports consistency, institutional knowledge, and defensibility over time.
  • Navigate novel product and data issues in a rapidly changing environment and help build practical, scalable frameworks as the product and data footprint grows.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a JD or equivalent law degree and are admitted to practice and in good standing in at least one U.S. state.
  • You have at least 4 years of experience as a practicing attorney at a law firm or in-house, advising on product and technology matters. Experience with data pipelines and data-driven businesses is a plus.
  • You have working knowledge of data and technology law and stay current on developments affecting product, data pipelines, and data-driven businesses.
  • You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are very comfortable engaging on technical topics with product and engineering teams, and can convey complex legal concepts in simple terms.
  • You are comfortable owning product and data legal review from early-stage ideation through late-stage launch, balancing true ownership of your workstreams with the judgment to know when to loop in others.
  • You thrive in the unknown, are motivated to think creatively each day, and can handle new and ambiguous product and data issues independently, including documenting clear, well-reasoned legal positions.
  • You are able to multitask, prioritize, and manage a large volume of requests with strong attention to detail, while maintaining the rigor needed for compliance-sensitive data and product work.

This is an exciting opportunity for a law firm associate or in-house product/technology attorney at a high-growth tech or data product company, with strong communication skills and impeccable judgment.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs (Austin, Cupertino, Los Angeles, and Miami), or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

What We Offer:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, unlimited vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

About Us

EnergyLink Sourcing LLC serves as the centralized supply chain arm of Quanta Services and its operating companies. Our centralized approach enables us to establish stronger partnerships across our supplier and client networks, improve material availability, and drive greater certainty of delivery for our customers. We are proud to support dynamic projects that power communities and drive progress.Our team is driven by integrity, responsiveness, and a commitment to delivering results. At EnergyLink, we believe in building long-term relationships with our clients, our partners, and our employees – grounded in trust, collaboration, and performance. We are committed to attracting and retaining top talent by offering competitive wages, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

About this Role

Senior Category Manager – Data Centers

EnergyLink | A Quanta Services Company

OWN THE CATEGORY. BUILD THE PARTNERSHIPS. POWER WHAT'S NEXT.

Big Projects. Bigger Impact. Your Next Career Move Starts Here.

Data centers are transforming the way the world connects, operates, and grows. Behind every successful project is a supply chain built on smart decisions, strong partnerships, and leaders who know how to deliver.

At EnergyLink, a Quanta Services Company, we're looking for a strategic, forward-thinking Senior Category Manager – Data Centers who knows how to turn complex sourcing challenges into competitive advantages.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages suppliers. We want a dealmaker, relationship builder, problem-solver, and strategic leader who understands what it takes to keep mission-critical infrastructure projects moving.

What You'll Do

You'll lead strategic sourcing initiatives for the equipment, materials, and services that power data center construction and operations.

  • Own Your Category: Develop and execute sourcing strategies that support current and future data center projects.

  • Make the Big Deals: Lead RFIs, RFPs, competitive bidding, supplier selection, and complex contract negotiations.

  • Build Powerful Partnerships: Develop relationships with manufacturers, distributors, and strategic suppliers across critical infrastructure categories.

  • Keep Projects Moving: Drive material availability, supplier capacity planning, and long-lead equipment strategies to support construction, commissioning, and energization schedules.

  • Drive Real Savings: Analyze spend, market conditions, and pricing trends to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or delivery.

  • Stay Ahead of the Market: Monitor supplier capacity, lead times, technology advancements, and supply chain risks.

  • Be the Problem Solver: Partner with engineering, construction, estimating, and operations to resolve supplier, specification, quality, and delivery challenges.

  • Lead Through Influence: Collaborate across EnergyLink and Quanta operating companies to align sourcing strategies with business growth.

  • Deliver Results: Establish supplier performance expectations, track KPIs, and continuously improve sourcing efficiency.

  • Think Bigger: Anticipate future demand and develop scalable sourcing solutions that position EnergyLink for long-term success.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who combines strategic sourcing expertise, data center industry knowledge, and strong leadership capabilities.

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management, including significant experience supporting data center construction or other mission-critical facilities.

  • 5+ years of direct leadership experience, with demonstrated success developing teams and driving measurable results.

  • Experience sourcing equipment, materials, or services within one or more critical data center infrastructure categories:

    • Electrical distribution and backup power

    • Mechanical and cooling systems

    • Controls and automation

    • Structured cabling and low-voltage systems

    • Data center construction materials

  • Proven ability to negotiate complex supplier agreements, manage strategic relationships, and deliver measurable cost savings.

  • Understanding of data center construction schedules, technical requirements, supplier markets, and long-lead equipment challenges.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in spend analytics, forecasting, supplier performance, and ERP/MRP systems.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, construction, finance, operations, and executive leadership.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field required.

  • Master's degree and professional certifications such as APICS, CPP, CPIM, CSCP, or CPPM preferred.

What You'll Get

At EnergyLink, we believe your career should offer more than a title. It should provide opportunities to grow, make an impact, and be part of something meaningful.

  • Competitive Compensation: A salary package aligned with your experience and qualifications.

  • Medical Coverage: Choice of a traditional PPO or two High-Deductible Health Plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas.

  • Health Savings Account (HSA): Company contributions of up to $500 for individual coverage or $1,000 for family coverage with an eligible plan.

  • Dental & Vision: Coverage options through MetLife and UnitedHealthcare Vision.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Company match of 100% on the first 3% contributed and 50% on the next 3%, with immediate vesting of company matching contributions.

  • Company-Paid Protection: Short- and long-term disability, plus company-provided life and AD&D insurance.

  • Paid Time Away: PTO, company-observed holidays, and additional eligible leave programs.

  • Career Development: Opportunities to expand your leadership capabilities, strengthen your industry expertise, and grow within the EnergyLink and Quanta Services organization.

  • Meaningful Work: The opportunity to help shape sourcing strategies supporting complex, mission-critical infrastructure projects.

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Privacy Legal team at Stripe tackles complex privacy issues that intersect with Stripe’s cutting-edge technology. We're seeking a technical and process-oriented lawyer with a passion for data, technology, privacy, and security. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of talented privacy lawyers to help solve intricate problems in a fast-paced environment.

What you’ll do

This role will be responsible for a wide variety of privacy matters. In addition to advising on product, regulatory, and operational privacy matters, you will also lead privacy legal workstreams for acquisitions and other strategic transactions, including post-close integration of acquired businesses, products, systems, and data practices.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as lead privacy counsel on important cross-functional initiatives, independently identifying and assessing complex privacy and security risks, and providing pragmatic, risk-based advice that advances Stripe’s business objectives.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Data Science, GTM, and other teams to design and implement privacy mitigations and embed privacy-by-design principles into Stripe’s products and operational processes.
  • Develop, enhance, and implement Stripe’s privacy infrastructure, policies, and procedures, setting short- to medium-term direction for assigned privacy programs and improving how privacy work scales across teams.
  • Lead privacy legal workstreams for acquisitions and other strategic transactions, from diligence through post-close integration. Identify and prioritize privacy risks; advise on deal terms, integration decisions, and remediation; and coordinate with Corporate Development, Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and other teams.
  • Own the privacy integration of acquired businesses, products, systems, and data practices, including the integration or remediation of data inventories, notices, consent practices, data-use purposes, retention requirements, data-subject rights processes, vendor arrangements, and privacy governance.
  • Lead or provide senior legal guidance for privacy compliance functions, including Data Protection Impact Assessments, Data Subject Access Requests, and Records of Processing Activities.
  • Lead the legal response to significant privacy and security incidents, coordinating cross-functional risk assessment, remediation, regulatory analysis, and breach-notification decisions.
  • Advise on complex commercial transactions and negotiate Data Processing Agreements and other privacy and security provisions, balancing legal risk with Stripe’s business objectives.
  • Help shape and implement Stripe’s privacy and data-governance approach for AI and machine learning.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • J.D. degree (or foreign equivalent) with membership in at least one US state bar.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a privacy lawyer, with extensive knowledge of global privacy laws and regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, and GLBA.
  • Experience leading privacy workstreams for acquisitions or other strategic transactions, including privacy diligence, risk assessment, and post-close integration or remediation.
  • A strong understanding of technology, data flows, and system architecture, with the ability to work directly with engineers, and to translate complex technical facts into practical legal advice and integration requirements.
  • Experience managing data-security incidents, and familiarity with data-breach notification requirements
  • Proficiency in negotiating and drafting complex contracts involving privacy and security terms.
  • Strong organizational and project leadership skills, including the ability to lead multiple complex, cross-functional workstreams, establish priorities, remove roadblocks, and drive matters to completion.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to make sound, independent, risk-based judgments in ambiguous or high-stakes situations while balancing privacy requirements with Stripe’s business objectives.
  • Ability to identify the right cross-functional stakeholders, build consensus, and drive implementation across teams with different priorities.
  • A pragmatic, hands-on approach, and the adaptability to move between strategic advice, detailed integration work, incident response, and program development.
  • A skilled advisor and negotiator who develops practical solutions and is regularly sought out for guidance on complex privacy matters.
  • Ability to communicate complex legal, technical, and business tradeoffs clearly, including preparing materials that enable senior leaders to make informed decisions.

raw.description:
Über Neolymp

Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Im DACH-Raum sind wir auf den großen Marktplätzen stark vertreten: Amazon ist unser wichtigster Kanal, dazu kommen Otto, Decathlon und unser eigener Onlineshop.

Unser Ziel ist klar: 100 % Wachstum pro Jahr bei starker Profitabilität. In den nächsten drei Jahren wollen wir auf 100 Mio. € Umsatz wachsen und dafür ein starkes Marketplace-Team aufbauen, das du leitest. Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unser Marktplatz-Geschäft und berichtest direkt an unseren Gründer & CEO, entscheidest sehr frei und wirst über Ziele geführt, nicht über Vorgaben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst die Marktplatz-Strategie: welche Kanäle, Länder und Produkte wir wann und wie skalieren, um unser Wachstum profitabel zu erreichen.
  • Du verantwortest Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag und Werbebudget aller Marktplätze und steuerst über klare Ziele und KPIs.
  • Du entwickelst Amazon, Otto und Decathlon gezielt weiter und erschließt neue Marktplätze und Länder.
  • Du führst das Marketplace-Team, setzt die Prioritäten im Tagesgeschäft und baust das Team auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. € aus.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Content, Design, Produktentwicklung und Logistik zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Listings, Launches und Bestände zur Strategie passen.
  • Du planst Produkt-Launches und Expansion auf den Marktplätzen mit.
  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Amazon, Otto, Decathlon, Agenturen und Dienstleister und verhandelst Konditionen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Marketplace-Geschäft, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in leitender Rolle.
  • Du kommst aus einem E-Commerce-Startup oder Scale-up, das bereits mindestens achtstellige Umsätze erzielt, und kannst konkret zeigen, wie du das Marktplatz-Geschäft dort entwickelt hast.
  • Tiefes Amazon-Know-how (Seller Central, Advertising, Brand Registry und Pan-EU).
  • Du kennst Otto und Decathlon als Marktplätze und hast idealerweise bereits mit ihnen gearbeitet.
  • Erfahrung mit internationaler Expansion.
  • Starkes Zahlenverständnis: Du denkst in Marge, Deckungsbeitrag und Lagerumschlag, nicht nur in Umsatz.
  • Führungserfahrung, idealerweise auch mit Remote-Teams.
  • Erfahrung im Consumer-Goods-Bereich, gern Sport oder Fitness, ist ein Plus.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und verhandlungssicheres Englisch.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine Marke auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. €: Du gestaltest starkes, profitables Wachstum und baust dabei dein eigenes Team auf.
  • Variable Vergütung: Zusätzlich zum Fixgehalt bist du am Erfolg beteiligt.
  • Echte Entscheidungsfreiheit: direkte Berichtslinie zum CEO, kurze Wege und Führung über Ziele.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten eigenverantwortlich.
  • Zusatzleistungen: moderne Hardware, Zugang zu Corporate Benefits, eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug und ein persönliches Educational Budget.
  • Startup-Umfeld: regelmäßige Team-Events in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wenn wir damit dein Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

raw.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

As a CPU Chiplet Architect at Tenstorrent, you will define the architecture for next-generation chiplet-based compute platforms, enabling high-performance RISC-V CPUs within scalable System-in-Package (SiP) solutions. You will own key platform subsystems—including PCIe, die-to-die connectivity, system management, and confidential computing—and work closely with architecture, hardware, software, and external IP partners to deliver robust, production-ready chiplet architectures.

This role isremote, based out of The United States.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • An experienced SoC or chiplet architect with a passion for defining scalable platform architectures.
  • A collaborative technical leader who can build alignment across architecture, hardware, software, and external partners.
  • Comfortable making architectural decisions in complex, fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
  • A proactive learner who enjoys mastering new technologies across hardware, firmware, and system software.
  • An excellent communicator who can clearly articulate architectural trade-offs and drive execution.

What We Need

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in SoC, CPU, or chiplet architecture for high-performance computing or server-class systems.
  • Strong expertise in PCI Express Root Complex, RCiEP, coherent fabrics (including CHI-C2C), IOMMU, ATS/PRI, MSI, CXL.mem, and confidential computing technologies such as TEE-I/O.
  • Deep understanding of system management, including boot, reset, debug, and power management for high-performance CPUs.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional architecture efforts, influence technical direction, and communicate effectively across engineering organizations.

What You Will Learn

  • How next-generation chiplet-based AI and CPU platforms are architected and integrated into scalable systems.
  • Advanced techniques for confidential computing, coherent fabrics, PCIe, and die-to-die communication in high-performance compute systems.
  • How hardware, firmware, operating systems, and virtualization technologies come together to enable modern server platforms.
  • Best practices for integrating third-party IP into complex SoCs while maintaining performance, security, and reliability.
  • How Tenstorrent develops industry-leading RISC-V platforms through close collaboration across global engineering teams.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.
