raw.description:
Overview

Shearer’s Foods, founded in 1974 and headquartered in Massillon, OH, is a leading manufacturer of salty snacks, cookies, and crackers. Specializing in private label and co-manufacturing, Shearer’s is the largest supplier of private brand salty snacks and second-largest supplier of private brand cookies and crackers.

With a strong focus on innovation, service, quality, and sustainability, Shearer’s has been awarded the food industry’s highest award for environmental sustainability, as well as multiple Supplier of the Year awards.

Operating 16 locations across North America and employing more than 5000 team members, Shearer’s is driven by its core values of People, Grow, Impact and Win. The company mission is to deliver exceptional products and services that make snacking a time to celebrate for our customers, colleagues, and community.

At Shearer’s Foods, we believe in a skills-first approach to recruitment and employment. This means focusing on what you can do and how you can grow, rather than traditional metrics alone. We are committed to adhering to anti-exclusion practices, removing barriers to access, and enhancing opportunities for all individuals based on merit and potential. Your skills, experience, and perspective are valuable—and we want to empower you to make your mark here with us. 

Responsibilities

Senior HRIS Analyst - Remote

The Senior HRIS Analyst, Talent System will serve as the functional and technical owner for iCIMS Applicant Tracking System and iCIMS Onboarding. Drive the performance and continuous improvement of recruiting and onboarding technology through effective platform configuration, release management, integrations, reporting, data integrity, security, and user support. You will also provide secondary administration and operational support across the broader HR technology portfolio, including ADP Workforce Now and SAP SuccessFactors Talent and Learning modules.

This senior individual-contributor role offers the opportunity to lead impactful recruiting and onboarding technology initiatives, partnering across HR, Talent Acquisition, and IT to drive innovation and streamline processes. Key responsibilities include:

iCIMS Platform Ownership

  • Serve as the primary functional and technical administrator for iCIMS Applicant Tracking System and iCIMS Onboarding.
  • Own configuration, workflows, forms, fields, security roles, reporting, integrations, release management, testing, system documentation, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage iCIMS system updates by reviewing release notes, determining which processes may be affected, coordinating testing with users, documenting changes before they are placed into production, and explaining relevant changes to Talent Acquisition and Plant HR.
  • Serve as the main contact for iCIMS support cases and work performed by iCIMS or outside implementation partners.
  • Ensure candidate and new-hire information transfers accurately and securely between iCIMS, ADP Workforce Now, background-screening providers, job boards, assessment tools, and identity or account-setup systems. Define field mappings and validation rules, monitor failures, coordinate issue resolution, and confirm data transfers are accurate and secure.
  • Configure secure processes within iCIMS Onboarding for collecting, routing, storing, and retaining candidate and new-hire documents. Eliminate email-based and other insecure document-handling workarounds within recruiting and onboarding.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards covering recruiting funnel performance, source effectiveness, time to fill, candidate conversion, onboarding completion, skipped or overdue process steps, and data quality. Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to define consistent metrics and validate reporting logic.
  • Evaluate configuration requests against standard iCIMS capabilities, company process standards, security requirements, and the effort required to maintain the solution over time. Recommend simpler alternatives when customization would create unnecessary complexity, inconsistent location practices, or excessive maintenance.
  • Maintain a current inventory of configurations, workflows, forms, fields, integrations, reports, security roles, vendor connections, dependencies, business purposes, and system owners.
  • Maintain and prioritize the iCIMS platform roadmap and enhancement backlog with Talent Acquisition and HR Technology leadership. Document the business problem, expected value, effort, risk, dependencies, and accountable business owner for each enhancement.
  • Monitor platform usage, system reliability, vendor support performance, support trends, and module adoption. Use this information to recommend renewals, module changes, vendor escalations, and outside consulting support. This role does not own contract negotiation or procurement.

Process Design and Candidate Experience

  • Partner with Plant HR Managers, Generalists, Coordinators, and Talent Acquisition to map current-state processes and design scalable digital workflows.
  • Design and continuously improve mobile-friendly recruiting and onboarding experiences for hourly and frontline candidates, accounting for limited computer access, varying levels of comfort with technology, multilingual needs, and time-sensitive plant hiring requirements. Monitor candidate drop-off and onboarding completion to identify and remove unnecessary friction.
  • Design system processes that work for frontline employees who may not have company email, regular computer access, or time away from the production floor during their shifts. Drive simplification and standardization across plants while accommodating legitimate local variation.

Integrations and Data Quality

  • Own the business requirements and continued reliability of iCIMS integrations. Partner with IT and vendors on technical design, monitoring, troubleshooting, and remediation.
  • Build and maintain reports that identify data errors, failed integrations, and recruiting or onboarding steps that are not being completed as designed.
  • Help ensure new-hire records use the correct employee IDs and organizational information when information moves from iCIMS into other HR systems.

Service Delivery and Knowledge Management

  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for the live iCIMS ATS and Onboarding systems. Diagnose underlying problems, resolve configuration and data issues, and coordinate with iCIMS or IT when escalation is needed. Document resolutions and identify recurring issues for permanent correction or user education.
  • Create and maintain administrator runbooks, configuration documentation, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and end-user job aids.
  • Cross-train designated HR Technology and Talent Acquisition partners to reduce key-person dependency and support continuity during absences or role transitions.
  • Train and support recruiters, Plant HR teams, and other users when new workflows or system features are introduced.

Security, Privacy, and Compliance

  • Administer and periodically review iCIMS security roles, user access, limited administrative access assigned to business users, and vendor access. Conduct reviews at least quarterly and upon material role changes; document approvals and remediation.
  • Design workflows and integrations so sensitive candidate and employee information is collected, transferred, stored, and accessed securely. Identify and remediate practices that expose sensitive information through insecure channels.
  • Maintain recruiting and onboarding configurations that support required recordkeeping, data integrity, and regulatory reporting. Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and Compliance to configure iCIMS and create reports that meet approved recordkeeping, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

How You’ll Work

  • Partner closely with the VP, HR Technology on prioritization, architecture, and roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership and recruiters to translate recruiting and onboarding needs into scalable system solutions. Talent Acquisition owns recruiting policy, recruiting and onboarding results, and user adoption; this role owns platform design, configuration, testing, system documentation, data integrity, and support.
  • Work effectively in a remote environment by maintaining reliable availability during agreed working hours, leading virtual requirements and design sessions, documenting decisions and follow-up actions, and traveling as needed for headquarters meetings, plant discovery, implementations, and major releases.
  • Future growth may include responsibility for additional HR systems, broader HR technology design work, or a leadership role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assess and document the current iCIMS ATS and Onboarding setup, resolve known defects, and establish a prioritized improvement backlog covering configurations, integrations, security roles, and process gaps.
  • Eliminate remaining paper-based onboarding workarounds at plants and establish a consistent, secure digital onboarding process.
  • Improve the accuracy of candidate and new-hire information transferred between systems through documented field mappings, validation controls, integration monitoring, and issue-resolution procedures.
  • Establish consistent practices for managing iCIMS updates, testing existing functions after changes, reviewing user access, and controlling changes to the live system.
  • Reduce recurring iCIMS support issues by fixing underlying problems, training users, and creating clear self-service documentation.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of HR technology, HRIS, or closely related experience, with increasing responsibility for system administration, configuration, or implementation, including at least 3 years administering and configuring enterprise HR systems.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience administering and configuring iCIMS Applicant Tracking System, including workflows, fields, user roles, reporting, integrations, and production support.
  • Hands-on experience administering iCIMS Onboarding, including onboarding workflows, forms, document handling, and new-hire data transfer.
  • Experience leading or having direct responsibility for requirements, configuration, testing, or deployment in at least one iCIMS implementation, reimplementation, module expansion, or significant platform redesign, including requirements gathering, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Demonstrated experience developing test plans and scripts, coordinating user acceptance testing, documenting results and defects, obtaining business approval, and managing controlled production changes.
  • Demonstrated experience administering HR or recruiting systems containing sensitive personal information, including role-based access, secure document handling, data-retention requirements, audit controls, and safe handling of live candidate and employee data during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current or recent iCIMS platform certification, formal iCIMS administrator training, or equivalent documented advanced platform experience.
  • Experience supporting HR system integrations, including APIs, middleware, file-based interfaces, field mapping, monitoring, and error resolution.
  • Experience building operational reports and dashboards using HR platform reporting tools or enterprise analytics platforms such as Power BI.
  • Experience supporting a multi-site manufacturing, food and beverage, or other frontline and shift-based workforce.
  • Experience with ADP Workforce Now, SAP SuccessFactors Talent or Learning, or comparable HCM and talent platforms.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Senior Product Manager who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. In healthcare, that includes the connected devices hospitals rely on for care: infusion pumps, imaging systems, patient monitors, and hospital building systems.

xDome provides visibility into these devices and supports exposure management, threat detection, network protection, secure access, and clinical operations. Claroty has been named Best in KLAS for Healthcare IoT Security for five consecutive years.

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead discovery, definition, and delivery of healthcare initiatives on xDome. You will own the healthcare roadmap and work with security, clinical engineering, and biomedical stakeholders, and with Claroty’s US field teams.

This is a remote position, with expected travel. Candidates must be located in EST time zone.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

  • Drive the Healthcare Roadmap: Set the roadmap for clinical engineering, biomedical / HTM, and security users, and align it with company priorities and engineering capacity
  • Product Adoption: Research how security and clinical engineering teams work, and define product for device context, ownership, and remediation in those workflows
  • Healthcare Data: Improve the device and clinical data in xDome. Work with medical device manufacturers on the data they provide, and guide the Data team’s priorities
  • Analyze the Market: Track how US health systems buy and run medical device security, and identify the product gaps that follow from that
  • Field Support: Partner with pre-sale and post-sale teams on US healthcare deals, and work through technical and clinical questions from large health systems
  • Customer Council: Run a healthcare customer council and use that feedback in the roadmap
  • Product GTM: Define success metrics and product messaging for exposure management, threat detection, network protection, secure access, and clinical operations
  • Enable the Field: Build playbooks and demo material for US sellers working with CISOs, clinical engineering leaders, and CIOs

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 6+ years in product management, with a record of shipping B2B products
  • Healthcare: Working knowledge of medical device security and clinical engineering. Experience at a health system, medical device company, or healthcare security company is strongly preferred
  • Stakeholders: Experience shipping product used by both security and clinical engineering teams
  • Data: Experience improving the quality of device data, including work with manufacturers or a data team

raw.description:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.

Über uns

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
  • Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
  • Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
  • Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
  • Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt
  • Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe
  • Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung
  • Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um
  • Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.

Was wir bieten

  • 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst
  • Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich
  • Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen
  • Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine
  • Ein klarer Weg nach oben: Wer sich bewährt, wird Chief of Staff und hat Karriereperspektiven bis in die Geschäftsführung oder auf C-Level

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte vier kurze Fragen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Fragen vorab beantwortet Felix Wilhelm gern unter +49 176 95422094.

The team owns the data that our sponsor banks, customers, and internal teams run on: the daily reporting suite our partner banks use to reconcile and oversee their card programs, the ledger and balance data behind Treasury, network reporting, and the analytics that drive product and business decisions. Much of this work ships to external parties on a schedule, so correctness and predictability matter as much as speed.

This is a role for an experienced manager who is ready to lead from day one, not a stepping stone into management. It is also a player-coach role: we expect roughly 20% to 30% of your time to be hands-on, reviewing models and pull requests, unblocking the team, and shipping when it counts. The stack is dbt, Snowflake, Airflow, and Omni, with SQL and Python throughout.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and grow a team of six analytics engineers, owning performance, development, and overall team health
  • Own the team's roadmap: scope it to real capacity, set dates the team can hit, and re-plan openly when priorities or estimates change
  • Partner with Product, Treasury, Finance, Partnerships, and peer engineering managers to agree on requirements and dependencies before dates are committed
  • Keep stakeholders and leadership informed with clear, complete status, including risks and slips, without being asked
  • Ensure the accuracy and on-time delivery of external data products, including daily bank reporting, balance and reconciliation files, and quarterly network reporting
  • Stay hands-on roughly 20% to 30% of the time: review dbt models and SQL, weigh in on data modeling and design, and contribute code
  • Set data architecture direction for the team in partnership with the Director: what belongs in the warehouse vs an operational store, and what is fit for an external API vs analytical reporting
  • Raise the bar on data quality and operations: testing, freshness and reconciliation checks, incident response, and documentation
  • Give regular, written feedback and build clear growth paths for each person on the team
  • Recruit, hire, and retain strong data talent

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years managing data, analytics engineering, or data engineering teams as a line manager, including coaching, written feedback, performance management, and hiring
  • A track record of running a team through a full roadmap cycle: planning against capacity, delivering to committed dates, and adjusting the plan in the open
  • Strong hands-on SQL and data modeling skills, with recent experience in a modern data stack (dbt, Snowflake or a similar warehouse, Airflow or a similar orchestrator)
  • Experience designing data systems that serve external consumers, and the judgment to explain the trade-offs
  • Experience owning data products with external consumers or contractual deadlines, where correctness is not negotiable
  • Proven ability to work across Product, Finance, and Engineering and to get alignment from peers before committing your team
  • Clear, direct communication, written and verbal, with engineers, executives, and non-technical partners
  • Comfort staying close to the work while delegating effectively
  • Experience with financial data (ledgers, reconciliation, payments, banking, or regulatory reporting) is strongly preferred
  • An interest in fintech and payments

The annual US salary range for this role is $169,000 - $265,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States or Canada (Ontario or British Columbia). We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Clinical Specialist I, CPT - Kansas City, MO


Working at Abbott


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:


  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

Neuromodulation


Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.


The Opportunity


Our team is actively recruiting for a Clinical Specialist I, CPTin Kansas City, MO. As a member of the clinical support team, is responsible for providing technical clinical expertise and support of the sales process to colleagues, current customers and/or potential customers. Works under general direction with clinical and sales teammates to identify and capitalize on sales opportunities by creating competency, comfort, and expertise with all Abbott Chronic Pain Therapies among physicians, support staff and customers within assigned geography. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing work. Seeks to continually improve territory efficiency.


What You’ll Work On


  • Provides technical, clinical, and programming assistance, primarily in support of 1-2 Territory Manager(s).
  • Assist Territory Managers in after-hours call support and activities.
  • Integrates into all accounts, builds trust and relationships, and establishes strong rapport with customers.
  • Proficient in complex programming, case support.
  • Works seamlessly with Territory Manager(s) allowing them increased selling time.
  • Will foster high trust relationships with customers, including the regional team members.
  • Will begin to conduct PCP work and educational in services, as directed.
  • As directed by sales manager, contacts, visits, and engages clients and potential clients in the Company’s products and addresses any client questions and concerns.
  • Provides medical professionals with sales support, information, and training on the use of Company products and with staff education, in-services, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain an in-depth knowledge of assigned accounts and customers to include competitor activity.
  • Conducts evaluations and develops sales strategies for capital equipment opportunities within accounts.
  • Collects and studies information about new and existing products and monitors competitor sales, prices, and products.
  • Provide feedback to providers both within operating room setting and outside operating room setting on the directions for use specific to implantable devices.
  • May attend trade shows where new products and technologies are showcased and conferences to meet other sales representatives and clients and discuss new product developments.
  • Uses clinical expertise to identify customer training and in-service needs with the goal of increasing customer usage, comfort and understating of all Abbott Chronic Pain Therapies product line.
  • Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments.
  • Provides sales support, clinical in-services, training, and guidance to current or potential customers.
  • Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned. 
  • Ability to travel 25% within assigned region and/or outside assigned region. 
     

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s Degree in biomedical engineering or related field or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • 1 - 2 years’ work experience, strong preference collaborating with patients in clinical setting.
  • The ability to communicate, understand and educate clinical data in the Chronic Pain Therapies space.
  • Strong clinical skills.
  • Excellent organizational, time management and prioritizing skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels and to large groups within and outside the organization.
  • Capable of building strong working relationships with internal/external customers.
  • Capable of working unpredictable schedule that may occasionally change on short notice due to operating room schedule changes and or delays.
  • Accustomed to tight deadlines and managing multiple tasks.
  • Strong sense of urgency.
  • Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
  • Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.
  • Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.
  • Multitasks, prioritizes, and meets deadlines in timely manner.
  • Capable of engaging customers in selling conversations as needed and as directed by Territory Manager.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Patient interaction experience within health care related environment (Physical Therapy, medical product sales, RN, LPN).
  • Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business unit model preferred.
  • 1-3 years’ experience with Abbott, or in similar spinal cord stimulation (SCS) setting or with another implantable medical device company.

Role Title: CrowdStrike Specialist
Role Type: Contract
Location: Remote

Required Skills: CrowdStrike Falcon, Cybersecurity, Endpoint security, EDR, Threat detection, Incident response, Security operations

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity invites professionals with hands-on CrowdStrike Falcon experience to demonstrate complex security workflows, provide actionable insights, and influence the future of AI-powered security solutions. Written and verbal communication skills are key, as you will contribute to clear, accurate documentation and knowledge transfer.

Scope of Work

  • Demonstrate CrowdStrike Falcon features and cybersecurity workflows within an approved environment for AI training purposes.

  • Analyze and explain endpoint security concepts, EDR processes, and security dashboards through detailed real-world examples.

  • Investigate and document security alerts and incident response procedures based on authentic threat detection scenarios.

  • Contribute to threat identification exercises and provide expert annotations on security data and events.

  • Develop and submit high-quality written and verbal explanations to articulate best practices and operational nuances.

  • Review and validate AI-generated outputs for technical accuracy in cybersecurity contexts.

  • Participate in feedback sessions to iteratively improve content relevance and instructional clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon in enterprise security environments.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of endpoint security, EDR, and threat detection methodologies.

  • Background in incident response or SOC operations, including investigation and remediation workflows.

  • Current, authorized access to CrowdStrike for compliant demonstration of features and processes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey technical concepts clearly and accurately.

  • Experience with security dashboard configuration, alert triage, and report generation.

  • Familiarity with AI, data annotation, or technical training content is a plus but not required.

Tasks

Are you a full-stack developer who loves delivering features from end to end?

Would you like to work in a start-up environment for the leader in Adtech analytics, using cutting-edge tools like Claude Code to accelerate your workflow?

If you enjoy working on problems involving large amounts of data, are curious, passionate, and care about delivering quality user experiences, join our team of talented developers.

No more silos: you own your features from start to finish.

You will participate in technical design workshops, propose improvements, and work closely with the Product team daily, as well as with our data engineers and data scientists.

  • Take the initiative to improve our architecture, design, and development workflows.

Our stack

  • 200+ AWS instances (EC2, S3, SQS, Cognito)

  • 10 TB+ of data ingested every day

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails, Grape API, Sidekiq, Python, Scala

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

  • Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, Redis, Elasticache

  • Testing: RSpec, Jest, Cypress

  • DevOps: Git, GitHub, GitHub A

Requirements

Core Skills

AI-Assisted Development

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar): code generation, refactoring, debugging, and codebase exploration. Ability to craft effective prompts and leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality.

Backend (Ruby on Rails)

  • Design, development, and maintenance of Ruby on Rails applications and RESTful APIs (including Grape). Strong focus on clean architecture, scalable patterns, performance, and performance.

  • Experience with testing (RSpec), code reviews, continuous integration, and technical documentation.

Frontend (React)

  • Development of modern web interfaces in React with TypeScript and JSX. Experience with state management (Redux, Zustand) and component-driven architecture. Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and component libraries such as shadcn/ui. Strong UX sensitivity and attention to user experience.

  • Experience setting up and maintaining tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress), and contributing to long-term maintainability

Data & Storage

  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing complex analytical queries. Familiarity with Snowflake is a plus but not required. Experience with environments mixing SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB/Mongoid), and performance/caching tools such as Redis and Elasticache.

Quality & Delivery

  • Strong engineering discipline: automation and tooling with GitHub, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), testing, linting (ESLint), and structured review processes. Experience working with cloud and scalable environments (AWS).

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails and React with TypeScript.

  • You're pragmatic and autonomous, able to take a feature from design to production.

  • You have strong SQL skills and experience with complex analytical queries (Snowflake is a plus)

  • You're comfortable working with REST APIs and distributed systems

  • You embrace modern development practices: testing, code reviews, CI/CD

  • You have strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with Product teams

  • You care about user experience and pay attention to detail

  • You are fluent in English. Proficiency in French is an asset

  • You are based in the CET/CEST timezone ± 2h (for team collaboration)

Benefits

  • Full remote

  • Macbook provide

Ready to join us?

If you're passionate about building quality software, excited about leveraging AI tools to boost your productivity, and want to work with a talented team on challenging ad tech problems, we'd love to hear from you!

At Adomik, we embrace modern development practices – including AI-assisted coding with tools like Claude Code – to help our developers focus on what matters most: solving complex problems and delivering value to our users.

Our recruitment process:

  • Technical assessment (coding challenge)

  • Team interviews (2)

  • Final discussion and offer

The process takes a few weeks. Apply now with your CV – we're looking forward to meeting you!
